rows.english: Likewise in one who effects that merit while aspiring to the delight of sense-sphere becoming and fine-material becoming because he is confused by ignorance.
rows.chinese_translation: 在缘无明而生起贪等时，它是所缘缘；在把无明看重而享受时，是所缘增上和所缘亲依止缘。

rows.pali: Anekadhā pana paresanti apuññābhisaṅkhārānaṃ anekadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 103. And for the next in many ways: it is a condition for formations of demerit in many ways.
rows.chinese_translation: 对于最后的不动行，认为无明仅以亲依止缘一种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Kathaṃ?
rows.english: How?
rows.chinese_translation: 它成为亲依止的情形，应依前面福行所说的方法理解。

rows.pali: Esā hi avijjaṃ ārabbha rāgādīnaṃ uppajjanakāle ārammaṇapaccayena, garuṃkatvā assādanakāle ārammaṇādhipatiārammaṇūpanissayehi, avijjāsammūḷhassa anādīnavadassāvino pāṇātipātādīni karontassa upanissayapaccayena, dutiyajavanādīnaṃ anantarasamanantaraanantarūpanissayāsevananatthivigatapaccayehi, yaṃkiñci akusalaṃ karontassa hetu sahajāta aññamañña nissaya sampayutta atthi avigatapaccayehīti anekadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: As object condition at the time of the arising of greed, etc., contingent upon ignorance; as object-predominance and object-decisive-support respectively at the times of giving importance [to ignorance] and enjoying [it]; as decisive-support in one who, being confused by ignorance and unaware of danger, kills living things, etc.; as proximity, contiguity, proximity-decisive- support, repetition, absence, and disappearance, for the second impulsion and those that follow; as root-cause, conascence, mutuality, support, association, presence, and non-disappearance, in one doing anything unprofitable. It is thus a condition in many ways.
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：难道只有无明是行的缘，还是还有其他缘？

rows.pali: Pacchimānaṃ sā ekadhā paccayo matāti āneñjābhisaṅkhārānaṃ upanissayapaccayeneva ekadhā paccayo matā.
rows.english: 104. But for the last kind only once: [542] it is reckoned as a condition in one way, namely, as decisive-support condition only, for formations of the imperturbable.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果只有无明，就会陷入单一原因论。

rows.pali: So panassā upanissayabhāvo puññābhisaṅkhāre vuttanayeneva veditabboti.
rows.english: But its relation as decisive-support condition should be understood as stated under formations of merit.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果还有其他缘，那么只说“以无明为缘而有行”这种单一原因的说明就不成立了。

rows.pali: 617.Etthāha – kiṃ panāyamekāva avijjā saṅkhārānaṃ paccayo, udāhu aññepi paccayā santīti?
rows.english: 105.Here it may be asked: But how is this? Is ignorance the only condition for formations, or are there other conditions?
rows.chinese_translation: 并不不成立。

rows.pali: Kiṃ panettha, yadi tāva ekāva, ekakāraṇavādo āpajjati.
rows.english: What is the position here? For firstly, if it is the only one, there follows the assertion of a single cause;17
rows.chinese_translation: 为什么？

rows.pali: Athaññepi santi, "avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā"ti ekakāraṇaniddeso nupapajjatīti?
rows.english: but then if there are others, the description of it as a single cause, namely, “With ignorance as condition there are formations,” is incorrect—
rows.chinese_translation: 因为这里既不是一个原因只产生一个结果，也不是多个原因只产生一个结果；说明一个原因和结果自有其意义。

rows.pali: Na nupapajjati.
rows.english: It is not incorrect.
rows.chinese_translation: 一个原因在这里不产生单一或多种结果。

rows.pali: Kasmā?
rows.english: Why not?
rows.chinese_translation: 多个原因也不只产生一个结果。

rows.pali: Yasmā –
rows.english: Here is the reason:
rows.chinese_translation: 多个原因产生的必定是多个结果。

rows.pali: Ekaṃ na ekato idha, nānekamanekatopi no ekaṃ;
rows.english: Nor from a single cause arise One fruit or many, nor one fruit from many;
rows.chinese_translation: 例如时节、土地、种子和水等多个原因，会产生芽这一类包含色、香、味等的多个结果。

rows.pali: Phalamatthi atthi pana eka-hetuphaladīpane attho.
rows.english: ’Tis helpful, though, to utilize One cause and fruit as representative.
rows.chinese_translation: 虽然说“以无明为缘而有行，以行缘而有识”，逐一说明一个原因和结果，但这种说法有其意义和作用。

rows.pali: Ekato hi kāraṇato na idha kiñci ekaṃ phalamatthi, na anekaṃ.
rows.english: 106. Here there is no single or multiple fruit of any kind from a single cause,
rows.chinese_translation: 世尊有时因主要，有时因明显，有时因不共，并随说法方便和受教者的情况，只说明一个原因或一个结果。

rows.pali: Nāpi anekehi kāraṇehi ekaṃ.
rows.english: nor a single fruit from multiple causes,
rows.chinese_translation: “以触为缘而有受”是因为触最主要，所以只说一个原因和结果。

rows.pali: Anekehi pana kāraṇehi anekameva hoti.
rows.english: but only multiple fruit from multiple causes.
rows.chinese_translation: 触是受的主要原因，因为受依不同触而确定。

rows.pali: Tathā hi anekehi utupathavībījasalilasaṅkhātehi kāraṇehi anekameva rūpagandharasādikaṃ aṅkurasaṅkhātaṃ phalaṃ uppajjamānaṃ dissati.
rows.english: So from multiple causes, in other words, from temperature, earth, seed, and moisture, is seen to arise a multiple fruit, in other words, the shoot, which has visible form, odour, taste, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 受是触的主要结果，因为触依不同受而确定。

rows.pali: Yaṃ panetaṃ "avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇa"nti ekekahetuphaladīpanaṃ kataṃ, tattha attho atthi, payojanaṃ vijjati.
rows.english: But one representative cause and fruit given in this way, “With ignorance as condition there are formations; with formations as condition, consciousness,” have a meaning and a use.
rows.chinese_translation: “由痰所生的疾病”是因其明显，所以只说一个原因。

rows.pali: Bhagavā hi katthaci padhānattā, katthaci pākaṭattā, katthaci asādhāraṇattā desanāvilāsassa ca veneyyānañca anurūpato ekameva hetuṃ vā phalaṃ vā dīpeti.
rows.english: 107. For the Blessed One employs one representative cause and fruit when it is suitable for the sake of elegance in instruction and to suit the idiosyncrasies of those susceptible of being taught. And he does so in some instances because it is a basic factor, and in some instances because it is the most obvious, and in some instances because it is not common to all.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里明显的是痰，而不是业等。

rows.pali: "Phassapaccayā vedanā"ti hi padhānattā ekameva hetuphalamāha.
rows.english: In the passage “With contact as condition, feeling” (M I 261) he mentions a single cause and fruit because they are basic factors.
rows.chinese_translation: “一切不善法都以不如理作意为根本”是因为它是不共原因，所以只说一个原因。

rows.pali: Phasso hi vedanāya padhānahetu yathāphassaṃ vedanā vavatthānato.
rows.english: For contact is the basic cause of feeling since the kinds of feeling are defined according to the kinds of contact [as “eye-contact-born feeling” and so on],
rows.chinese_translation: 不如理作意是不善法的不共原因，而所依、所缘等是共同原因。

rows.pali: Vedanā ca phassassa padhānaphalaṃ yathāvedanaṃ phassavavatthānato.
rows.english: and feeling is contact’s basic fruit since contact is defined according to the kinds of feeling [that it produces].
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，虽然所依、所缘、俱生法等也存在于行的诸因中，这里仍特意说无明，是因为受味观察时爱增长，以及无明集起时诸漏集起等。

rows.pali: "Semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā"ti (a. ni. 10.60) pākaṭattā ekaṃ hetumāha.
rows.english: He mentions a single cause in the passage “Disease due to phlegm” (A V 110) because that is the most obvious.
rows.chinese_translation: 由此关于排除逐一说明单一因果的解释，应知一切地方逐一说明一个因果都有其作用。

rows.pali: Pākaṭo hi ettha semho, na kammādayo.
rows.english: For here what is obvious is the phlegm, not the kamma, etc., [mentioned later in the same sutta].
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：既然如此，无明必定只产生不善结果、且属于应受谴责法，怎么能成为福行和不动行的缘？

rows.pali: "Ye keci, bhikkhave, akusalā dhammā, sabbe te ayonisomanasikāramūlakā"ti asādhāraṇattā ekaṃ hetumāha.
rows.english: He mentions a single cause in the passage “Bhikkhus, any states whatever that are unprofitable are all rooted in unwise attention” (cf. S V 91) because it is not common to all.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为不会从苦楝种子生出甘蔗。

rows.pali: Asādhāraṇo hi ayonisomanasikāro akusalānaṃ, sādhāraṇāni vatthārammaṇādīnīti.
rows.english: For unwise attention to unprofitable things is not common to all [states] in the way that, say, physical basis and object are common to all.
rows.chinese_translation: 不如理作意是不善法的不共原因，而所依、所缘等是共同原因。

rows.pali: Tasmā ayamidha avijjā vijjamānesupi aññesu vatthārammaṇasahajātadhammādīsu saṅkhārakāraṇesu "assādānupassino taṇhā pavaḍḍhatī"ti (saṃ. ni. 2.52) ca "avijjāsamudayā āsavasamudayo"ti (ma. ni. 1.104) ca vacanato aññesampi taṇhādīnaṃ saṅkhārahetūnaṃ hetūti padhānattā, "avidvā, bhikkhave, avijjāgato puññābhisaṅkhārampi abhisaṅkharotī"ti pākaṭattā, asādhāraṇattā ca saṅkhārānaṃ hetubhāvena dīpitāti veditabbā.
rows.english: 108. Consequently, although other causes of formations such as physical basis and object, conascent states, etc., are actually existent, still ignorance may be understood as the representative cause of formations [firstly] because it is the basic factor as the cause of other causes of formations such as craving, etc., as it is said: “Craving increases in one who dwells seeing enjoyment” (S II 84), and “With the arising of ignorance there is the arising of cankers” (M I 55); and again because it is the most obvious, “Not knowing, bhikkhus, in ignorance, he forms the formation of merit” (cf. S II 82); and lastly because it is not common to all.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，虽然所依、所缘、俱生法等也存在于行的原因中，这里仍特意说无明，正如经说观察味着时爱增长、无明集起时诸漏集起。

rows.pali: Eteneva ca ekekahetuphaladīpanaparihāravacanena sabbattha ekekahetuphaladīpane payojanaṃ veditabbanti.
rows.english: So the use of one representative cause and fruit should in each instance be understood according to this explanation of it. 18
rows.note: 18.Parihāra-vacana—“explanation”: not in PED in this sense.
rows.chinese_translation: 由此可知，凡是排除逐一说明单一因果的地方，逐一说明一个因果都有其作用。

rows.pali: 618.Etthāha – evaṃ santepi ekantāniṭṭhaphalāya sāvajjāya avijjāya kathaṃ puññāneñjābhisaṅkhārapaccayattaṃ yujjati?
rows.english: 109. Here it may be said: “We admit that. But ignorance is reprehensible and has entirely undesirable fruit. How then can it rightly be a condition for formations of merit and of the imperturbable?
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：既然如此，必定产生不善结果且属于应受谴责的无明，怎么能成为福行和不动行的缘？

rows.pali: Na hi nimbabījato ucchu uppajjatīti.
rows.english: Sugarcane does not grow from [bitter] nimba seeds.”
rows.chinese_translation: 因为不会从苦楝种子生出甘蔗。

rows.pali: Kathaṃ na yujjissati?
rows.english: Why should it not be right?
rows.chinese_translation: 怎么会不相应呢？

rows.pali: Lokasmiñhi –
rows.english: For in the world [that is, even among thinkers outside the Dispensation it is recognized that]
rows.chinese_translation: 世间已经确认，法彼此可以成为相违或不相违、相似或不相似的缘，但不一定是异熟果。

rows.pali: Viruddho cāviruddho ca, sadisāsadiso tathā;
rows.english: Both as opposed and unopposed A state’s conditions may be found,
rows.chinese_translation: 法在处所、本性、作用等方面相违或不相违，都可以成为缘。

rows.pali: Dhammānaṃ paccayo siddho, vipākā eva te ca na.
rows.english: And both as like and unlike too: That does not make it their result.
rows.chinese_translation: 前一心是后一心处所方面相违的缘，先前学习的技艺是后来进行技艺活动的缘。

rows.pali: Dhammānaṃ hi ṭhānasabhāvakiccādiviruddho cāviruddho ca paccayo loke siddho.
rows.english: 110. It is established in the world that when states have a condition, it may be opposed or unopposed to them as to presence, individual essence, function, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 业是色法本性方面相违的缘，乳等是凝乳等的缘。

rows.pali: Purimacittaṃ hi aparacittassa ṭhānaviruddho paccayo, purimasippādisikkhā ca pacchā pavattamānānaṃ sippādikiriyānaṃ.
rows.english: For a preceding consciousness is a condition, opposed as to presence, for the succeeding consciousness; and the preceding training is a condition likewise for the plying of crafts, etc., which take place subsequently.
rows.chinese_translation: 光是眼识作用方面相违的缘，糖浆等是诸漏等的缘。

rows.pali: Kammaṃ rūpassa sabhāvaviruddho paccayo, khīrādīni ca dadhiādīnaṃ.
rows.english: Kamma is a condition, opposed as to individual essence, for materiality; and so are milk, etc., for curds, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 眼、色等则是眼识等处所方面不相违的缘。

rows.pali: Āloko cakkhuviññāṇassa kiccaviruddho, guḷādayo ca āsavādīnaṃ.
rows.english: Light is a condition, opposed as to function, for eye-consciousness; and so are molasses, etc., for intoxicants, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 前前速行等对后后速行等，在本性和作用方面都不相违。

rows.pali: Cakkhurūpādayo pana cakkhuviññāṇādīnaṃ ṭhānāviruddhā paccayā.
rows.english: But eye-cum-visible-data, etc., are respectively a condition, unopposed as to presence, for eye-consciousness, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 正如相违与不相违的缘成立，相似与不相似的缘也成立。

rows.pali: Purimajavanādayo pacchimajavanādīnaṃ sabhāvāviruddhā kiccāviruddhā ca.
rows.english: And the first impulsion, and those that follow, are a condition, unopposed as to individual essence and function, for the impulsions that follow them.
rows.chinese_translation: 时节和食物所成的色法，以相似性成为色法的缘；稻种等成为稻果等的缘。

rows.pali: Yathā ca viruddhāviruddhā paccayā siddhā, evaṃ sadisāsadisāpi.
rows.english: And just as conditions operate as opposed and unopposed, so also they operate as like and unlike.
rows.chinese_translation: 不相似的色法也能成为无色法的缘，无色法也能成为色法的缘；牛毛、反牛毛、兽角、凝乳、芝麻粉等可成为匍匐草等的缘。

rows.pali: Sadisameva hi utuāhārasaṅkhātaṃ rūpaṃ rūpassa paccayo, sālibījādīni ca sāliphalādīnaṃ.
rows.english: Materiality—for example, temperature and nutriment—is a condition for materiality: the like for the like. And so are paddy seeds, etc., for paddy crops, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 凡是以相违、不相违、相似、不相似为缘的诸法，并不一定就是那些法的异熟果。

rows.pali: Asadisampi rūpaṃ arūpassa, arūpañca rūpassa paccayo hoti, golomāviloma-visāṇa-dadhitilapiṭṭhādīni ca dubbā-sarabhūtiṇakādīnaṃ.
rows.english: The material is a condition for the immaterial, and so is the immaterial for the material: the unlike for the like. And so are ox hair and ram’s hair, horns, curd, and sesame flour, etc., respectively for dabba grass, reeds, bhūtanaka grass, and so on. 19
rows.note: 19. Avi—“a goat or sheep”: not in PED. The Vism text reads “golomāvilomavisāṇa- dadhitilapiṭṭhādīni ca dubbāsarabhūtanakādīnaṃ.” ...
rows.chinese_translation: 所以，无明就异熟而言必定产生不受欢迎的结果，就本性而言虽属应受谴责，却仍能依各自相应的处所、作用和本性相违或不相违而成为福行等的缘。

rows.pali: Yesañca dhammānaṃ te viruddhāviruddhasadisāsadisapaccayā, na te dhammā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā eva.
rows.english: And those states for which these are the opposed and unopposed, like and unlike, conditions are not the results of these states as well.
rows.chinese_translation: 无明成为它们缘的情形，正如前面说的迷惑者把轮回苦当作快乐并造作其原因。

rows.pali: Iti ayaṃ avijjā vipākavasena ekantāniṭṭhaphalā, sabhāvavasena ca sāvajjāpi samānā sabbesampi etesaṃ puññābhisaṅkhārādīnaṃ yathānurūpaṃ ṭhānakiccasabhāvaviruddhāviruddhapaccayavasena, sadisāsadisapaccayavasena ca paccayo hotīti veditabbā.
rows.english: 111. So although this ignorance has entirely undesirable fruit for its result and is reprehensible in its individual essence, yet it should be understood as a condition, opposed or unopposed and like or unlike as the case may be, as to presence, function, and individual essence, for all these formations of merit, etc.
rows.chinese_translation: 此外还有另一种解释。

rows.pali: So cassā paccayabhāvo "yassa hi dukkhādīsu avijjāsaṅkhātaṃ aññāṇaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti, so dukkhe tāva pubbantādīsu ca aññāṇena saṃsāradukkhaṃ sukhasaññāya gahetvā tassa hetubhūte tividhepi saṅkhāre ārabhatī"tiādinā nayena vutto eva.
rows.english: And its state as a condition has already been given in the way beginning, “For when unknowing—in other words, ignorance—of suffering, etc., is unaban- doned in a man, owing firstly to his unknowing about suffering and about the past, etc., then be believes the suffering of the round of rebirths to be pleasant and he embarks upon the three kinds of formations, which are the cause of that very suffering” (§62).
rows.chinese_translation: 在死、生、轮回、行的特征以及缘生法上迷惑的人，

rows.pali: 619.Apica ayaṃ aññopi pariyāyo –
rows.english: 112. Moreover, there is this way of explanation as well:
rows.chinese_translation: 因此造作这三种行；无明是它们的缘，因为这种迷惑遍及三类行。

rows.pali: Cutūpapāte saṃsāre, saṅkhārānañca lakkhaṇe;
rows.english: Now, when a man is ignorant Of death and rebirth and the round,
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：迷惑于这些法的人，怎样会造作这三种行？

rows.pali: Yo paṭiccasamuppanna-dhammesu ca vimuyhati.
rows.english: The characteristics of the formed, Dependently-arisen states, [544]
rows.chinese_translation: 迷惑于死的人，不理解一切处蕴的破坏就是死亡，反而认为有情死亡并转移到另一个身体。

rows.pali: Abhisaṅkharoti so ete, saṅkhāre tividhe yato;
rows.english: And in his ignorance he forms Formations of this triple kind,
rows.chinese_translation: 迷惑于生的人，不理解一切处蕴的出现就是生，反而认为有情投生、出现新身体。

rows.pali: Avijjā paccayo tesaṃ, tividhānampayaṃ tatoti.
rows.english: Then ignorance itself will be Condition for each of the three.
rows.chinese_translation: 迷惑于轮回的人，不理解所谓轮回是蕴、界、处的次第连续运转。

rows.pali: Kathaṃ pana yo etesu vimuyhati, so tividhepete saṅkhāre karotīti ce.
rows.english: 113. But how does a man who is confused about these things perform these three kinds of formations?
rows.chinese_translation: 因此他不接受这种所说的轮回，反而想象有情从此世往彼世去、又从彼世来到此世等。

rows.pali: Cutiyā tāva vimūḷho "sabbattha khandhānaṃ bhedo maraṇa"nti cutiṃ agaṇhanto "satto marati, sattassa dehantarasaṅkamana"ntiādīni vikappeti.
rows.english: Firstly, when he is confused about death, instead of taking death thus, “Death in every case is break-up of aggregates,” he figures that it is a [lasting] being that dies, that it is a [lasting] being’s transmigration to another incarnation, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 迷惑于行的特征的人，不理解行的自相和共相，反而把行想作自我、我所有、恒常、快乐、美好。

rows.pali: Upapāte vimūḷho "sabbattha khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo jātī"ti upapātaṃ agaṇhanto "satto upapajjati, sattassa navasarīrapātubhāvo"tiādīni vikappeti.
rows.english: 114. When he is confused about reappearance, instead of taking rebirth thus, “Birth in every case is manifestation of aggregates,” he figures that it is a lasting being’s manifestation in a new body.
rows.chinese_translation: 迷惑于缘生法的人，不理解无明等使行等运转，反而想象有自我知道或不知道，自我造作并使他人造作。

rows.pali: Saṃsāre vimūḷho yo esa,
rows.english: 115. when he is confused about the round of rebirths,
rows.chinese_translation: 他在结生时投生，微细的识等以胚胎等状态形成身体并使诸根具足。

rows.pali: "Khandhānañca paṭipāṭi, dhātuāyatanāna ca;
rows.english: The endless chain of aggregates, Of elements, of bases too,
rows.chinese_translation: 他具足诸根后接触、感受、生爱、执取并努力活动。

rows.pali: Abbocchinnaṃ vattamānā, saṃsāroti pavuccatī"ti. –
rows.english: That carries on unbrokenly Is what is called “the round of births,”
rows.chinese_translation: 随后他又在另一有中存在，或者想象一切有情都受命运、趣和状态支配而成熟。

rows.pali: Evaṃ vaṇṇito saṃsāro, taṃ evaṃ agaṇhanto "ayaṃ satto asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokaṃ āgacchatī"tiādīni vikappeti.
rows.english: instead of taking the round of rebirths as pictured thus, he figures that it is a lasting being that goes from this world to another world, that comes from another world to this world.
rows.chinese_translation: 这个人被无明蒙蔽而如此想象，正如天生盲人行走于大地，既走正路也走邪路，既走高地也走低地，既走平地也走险地；他也同样造作福、非福和不动行。

rows.pali: Saṅkhārānaṃ lakkhaṇe vimūḷho saṅkhārānaṃ sabhāvalakkhaṇaṃ sāmaññalakkhaṇañca agaṇhanto saṅkhāre attato attaniyato dhuvato sukhato subhato vikappeti.
rows.english: 116. When he is confused about the characteristics of formations, instead of apprehending their specific and general characteristics, he figures that formations are self, belong to a self, are lasting, pleasant, beautiful.
rows.chinese_translation: 所以说：

rows.pali: Paṭiccasamuppannadhammesu vimūḷho avijjādīhi saṅkhārādīnaṃ pavattiṃ agaṇhanto "attā jānāti vā na jānāti vā, so eva karoti ca kāreti ca.
rows.english: 117. When he is confused about dependently-arisen states, instead of taking the occurrence of formations to be due to ignorance, etc., he figures that it is a self that knows or does not know, that acts and causes action,
rows.chinese_translation: 正如天生盲人无人引导，

rows.pali: So paṭisandhiyaṃ upapajjati, tassa aṇuissarādayo kalalādibhāvena sarīraṃ saṇṭhapento indriyāni sampādenti.
rows.english: that appears in rebirth- linking, and he figures that atoms, an Overlord, etc., shape its body in the various states of the embryo and endow it with faculties,
rows.chinese_translation: 有时走在正路，有时走上岔路。

rows.pali: So indriyasampanno phusati, vediyati, taṇhīyati, upādiyati, ghaṭiyati.
rows.english: and that when it has been endowed with faculties it touches, feels, craves, clings, and endeavours,
rows.chinese_translation: 愚人在轮回中流转，也同样无人引导，

rows.pali: So puna bhavantare bhavatī"ti vā, "sabbe sattā niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā"ti (dī. ni. 1.168) vā vikappeti.
rows.english: and that it becomes anew in the next becoming; or he figures thus, “All beings … [are] moulded by fate, coincidence and nature” (D I 53).
rows.chinese_translation: 有时造福，有时也造非福。

rows.pali: So avijjāya andhīkato evaṃ vikappento yathā nāma andho pathaviyaṃ vicaranto maggampi amaggampi thalampi ninnampi samampi visamampi paṭipajjati, evaṃ puññampi apuññampi āneñjābhisaṅkhārampi abhisaṅkharotīti.
rows.english: 118. Thus he figures, blinded by ignorance. He is like a blind man who wanders about the earth, encountering now right and now wrong paths, now heights and now hollows, now even and now uneven ground, and so he forms formations now of merit, now of demerit, now imperturbable.
rows.chinese_translation: 当他认识此法并通达诸谛时，

rows.pali: Tenetaṃ vuccati –
rows.english: 119. Hence this is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 无明平息，他便寂静而行。

rows.pali: "Yathāpi nāma jaccandho, naro apariṇāyako;
rows.english: As one born blind, who gropes along Without assistance from a guide,
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是“以无明为缘而有行”的详细说明。

rows.pali: Ekadā yāti maggena, ummaggenāpi ekadā.
rows.english: Chooses a road that may be right At one time, at another wrong,
rows.chinese_translation: 在“以行缘而有识”一项中，识有眼识等六种。

rows.pali: "Saṃsāre saṃsaraṃ bālo, tathā apariṇāyako;
rows.english: So while the foolish man pursues The round of births without a guide,
rows.chinese_translation: 其中眼识分为善异熟和不善异熟两种。

rows.pali: Karoti ekadā puññaṃ, apuññamapi ekadā.
rows.english: Now to do merit he may choose And now demerit in such plight.
rows.chinese_translation: 耳识、鼻识、舌识和身识也同样如此。

rows.pali: "Yadā ca ñatvā so dhammaṃ, saccāni abhisamessati;
rows.english: But when the Dhamma he comes to know And penetrates the truths besides,
rows.chinese_translation: 当他认识此法并通达诸谛时，

rows.pali: Tadā avijjūpasamā, upasanto carissatī"ti.
rows.english: Then ignorance is put to flight At last, and he in peace may go.
rows.chinese_translation: 无明平息，他便寂静而行。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ "avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā"ti padasmiṃ vitthārakathā.
rows.english: This is the detailed explanation of the clause, “With ignorance as condition there are formations.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是“以无明为缘而有行”的详细说明。

rows.pali: 620.Saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇapade – viññāṇanti cakkhuviññāṇādi chabbidhaṃ.
rows.english: 120. In the clause, with formations as condition, consciousness, consciousness is sixfold as eye-consciousness, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 在“以行缘而有识”一项中，识有眼识等六种。

rows.pali: Tattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ kusalavipākaṃ akusalavipākanti duvidhaṃ hoti.
rows.english: Herein, eye-consciousness is twofold, namely, profitable [kamma-]resultant and unprofitable [kamma-]resultant (see Table II for bracketed numbers that follow).
rows.chinese_translation: 其中眼识分为善异熟和不善异熟两种。

rows.pali: Tathā sotaghānajivhākaāyaviññāṇāni.
rows.english: Likewise ear-, nose-, tongue-, and body-consciousness ((34)–(38) and (50)–(54)).
rows.chinese_translation: 耳、鼻、舌、身识也同样分为两种。

rows.pali: Manoviññāṇaṃ kusalākusalavipākā dve manodhātuyo, tisso ahetukamanoviññāṇadhātuyo, aṭṭha sahetukāni kāmāvacaravipākacittāni, pañca rūpāvacarāni, cattāri arūpāvacarānīti bāvīsatividhaṃ hoti.
rows.english: But mind-consciousness is twenty- two-fold, namely, the two profitable and unprofitable resultant mind elements ((39) and (55)), the three root-causeless mind-consciousness elements ((40), (41) and (56)), the eight sense-sphere resultant consciousnesses with root-cause ((42)–(49)), the five of the fine-material sphere ((57)–(61)), and the four of the immaterial sphere ((62)–(65)).
rows.chinese_translation: 意识包括两种善不善异熟的意界、三种无因意识界、八种有因欲界异熟心、五种色界心和四种无色界心，共二十二种。

rows.pali: Iti imehi chahi viññāṇehi sabbānipi bāttiṃsa lokiyavipākaviññāṇāni saṅgahitāni honti.
rows.english: So all the thirty-two mundane resultant consciousnesses ((34)–(65)) are included by these six kinds of consciousness.
rows.chinese_translation: 这六种识总摄一切三十二种世间异熟识。

rows.pali: Lokuttarāni pana vaṭṭakathāya na yujjantīti na gahitāni.
rows.english: But the supramundane kinds do not belong to the exposition of the round [of becoming], and so they are not included.
rows.chinese_translation: 出世间识不适用于轮回的说明，所以不列入。

rows.pali: Tattha siyā "kathaṃ panetaṃ jānitabbaṃ idaṃ vuttappakāraṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā hotī"ti?
rows.english: 121. Here it may be asked: “But how is it to be known that this consciousness of the kind stated actually has formations as its condition?”
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：怎样知道这里所说的识是以行作为缘？

rows.pali: Upacitakammābhāve vipākābhāvato.
rows.english: —Because there is no kamma-result when there is no stored-up kamma.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为没有积集的业，就没有异熟。

rows.pali: Vipākaṃ hetaṃ, vipākañca na upacitakammābhāve uppajjati.
rows.english: For this consciousness is kamma-result, and kamma-result does not arise in the absence of stored-up kamma.
rows.chinese_translation: 这是异熟，而异熟不会在没有积集业时生起。

rows.pali: Yadi uppajjeyya sabbesaṃ sabbavipākāni uppajjeyyuṃ, na ca uppajjantīti jānitabbametaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā idaṃ viññāṇaṃ hotīti.
rows.english: If it did, then all kinds of kamma-resultant consciousnesses would arise in all kinds of beings, and they do not do so. This is how it should be known that such consciousness has formations as its condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果会生起，一切人的一切异熟都应生起；但事实并非如此，所以应知这种识是以行作为缘。

rows.pali: Katarasaṅkhārapaccayā kataraṃ viññāṇanti ce.
rows.english: 122. But which kind of consciousness has which kind of formations as its condition?
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：哪一种行是哪些识的缘？

rows.pali: Kāmāvacarapuññābhisaṅkhārapaccayā tāva kusalavipākāni pañca cakkhuviññāṇādīni, manoviññāṇe ekā manodhātu, dve manoviññāṇadhātuyo, aṭṭha kāmāvacaramahāvipākānīti soḷasa.
rows.english: Firstly, the following sixteen kinds arise with the sense-sphere formation of merit as condition: the five profitable resultants beginning with eye- consciousness ((34)–(38)), and in the case of mind-consciousness one kind of mind element (39) and two kinds of mind-consciousness element ((40)–(41)), and the eight kinds of sense-sphere resultant ((42)–(49)),
rows.chinese_translation: 首先，以欲界福行作为缘，会产生五种善异熟眼等识。

rows.pali: Yathāha –
rows.english: according as it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 在意识中，会产生一种意界、两种意识界和八种欲界大异熟心，共十六种。

rows.pali: "Kāmāvacarassa kusalassa kammassa kaṭattā upacitattā vipākaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti… sota… ghāna… jivhā… kāyaviññāṇaṃ … vipākā manodhātu uppannā hoti.
rows.english: Owing to profitable kamma of the sense sphere having been performed, stored up, resultant eye-consciousness” (Dhs §431), “ear-, nose-, tongue-, body- consciousness” (Dhs §443), “resultant mind element arises” (Dhs §455),
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说：由于欲界善业已造作并积集，异熟眼识生起；耳、鼻、舌、身识也如此，异熟意界生起。

rows.pali: Somanassasahagatā manoviññāṇadhātu uppannā hoti.
rows.english: “mind- consciousness element accompanied by joy arises” (Dhs §469),
rows.chinese_translation: 伴随喜受的意识界生起，伴随舍受的意识界也生起。

rows.pali: Upekkhāsahagatā manoviññāṇadhātu uppannā hoti.
rows.english: “mind- consciousness element accompanied by equanimity arises” (Dhs §484),
rows.chinese_translation: 其中有伴随喜受、与智相应的意识界。

rows.pali: Somanassasahagatā ñāṇasampayuttā.
rows.english: “accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随喜受、与智相应且有行的意识界。

rows.pali: Somanassasahagatā ñāṇasampayuttā sasaṅkhārena.
rows.english: accompanied by joy, associated with knowledge and prompted …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随喜受、与智不相应的意识界。

rows.pali: Somanassasahagatā ñāṇavippayuttā.
rows.english: accompanied by joy and dissociated from knowledge …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随喜受、与智不相应且有行的意识界。

rows.pali: Somanassasahagatā ñāṇavippayuttā sasaṅkhārena.
rows.english: accompanied by joy, dissociated from knowledge and prompted …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随舍受、与智相应的意识界。

rows.pali: Upekkhāsahagatā ñāṇasampayuttā.
rows.english: accompanied by equanimity and associated with knowledge …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随舍受、与智相应且有行的意识界。

rows.pali: Upekkhāsahagatā ñāṇasampayuttā sasaṅkhārena.
rows.english: accompanied by equanimity, associated with knowledge and prompted …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随舍受、与智不相应的意识界。

rows.pali: Upekkhāsahagatā ñāṇavippayuttā.
rows.english: accompanied by equanimity and dissociated from knowledge …
rows.chinese_translation: 有伴随舍受、与智不相应且有行的意识界。

rows.pali: Upekkhāsahagatā ñāṇavippayuttā sasaṅkhārenā"ti (dha. sa. 431, 498).
rows.english: accompanied by equanimity, dissociated from knowledge and prompted” (Dhs §498).
rows.chinese_translation: 以上是经论列举的八种欲界大异熟心。

rows.pali: Rūpāvacarapuññābhisaṅkhārapaccayā pana pañca rūpāvacaravipākāni.
rows.english: 123. There are five kinds of resultant fine-material-sphere consciousness ((57)– (61)) with the fine-material-sphere formation of merit as condition,
rows.chinese_translation: 以色界福行作为缘，则产生五种色界异熟识。

rows.pali: Yathāha –
rows.english: according as it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说，由于同一色界善业已造作并积集，异熟第一禅乃至第五禅生起。

rows.pali: "Tasseva rūpāvacarassa kusalassa kammassa kaṭattā upacitattā vipākaṃ vivicceva kāmehi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ - pe - pañcamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī"ti (dha. sa. 499).
rows.english: “Owing to that same profitable kamma of the fine-material sphere having been performed, stored up, [by the development of that same profitable jhāna,] [546] secluded from sense desires … he enters upon and dwells in the resultant first jhāna … fifth jhāna” (Dhs §499).
rows.chinese_translation: 同一色界善业已经造作并积集，所以异熟的初禅乃至第五禅生起。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Evaṃ puññābhisaṅkhārapaccayā ekavīsatividhaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti.
rows.english: 124. There are seven kinds of consciousness with the formation of demerit as condition:
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，以福行为缘的识共有二十一种。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Apuññābhisaṅkhārapaccayāpana akusalavipākāni pañca cakkhuviññāṇādīni, ekā manodhātu, ekā manoviññāṇadhātūti evaṃ sattavidhaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti.
rows.english: the five unprofitable resultants beginning with eye-consciousness ((50)–(54)), one mind element (55), and one mind-consciousness element (56),
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说，由于不善业已造作并积集，异熟眼识等、异熟意界和异熟意识界生起。

rows.pali: Yathāha –
rows.english: according as it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 不善业已经造作并积集，所以异熟的眼识、耳识、鼻识、舌识、身识、意界和意识界生起。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: "Akusalassa kammassa kaṭattā upacitattā vipākaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti… sota… ghāna… jivhā… kāyaviññāṇaṃ… vipākā manodhātu vipākā manoviññāṇadhātu uppannā hotī"ti (dha. sa. 556).
rows.english: “Because of unprofitable kamma having been performed and stored up, resultant eye-consciousness has arisen … ear- … nose- … tongue- … body-consciousness has arisen” (Dhs §556), “resultant mind element” (Dhs §562), “resultant mind-consciousness element has arisen” (Dhs §564).
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说，由于同一无色界善业已造作并积集，超越一切色想后，空无边处等识相应的异熟识生起。

rows.pali: Āneñjābhisaṅkhārapaccayā pana cattāri arūpavipākānīti evaṃ catubbidhaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti.
rows.english: 125.There are four kinds of immaterial resultant consciousness ((62)–(65)) with the formation of the imperturbable as condition,
rows.chinese_translation: 知道哪一种识由哪一种行作为缘后，现在应知它的运作方式；一切识依现行和结生分为两类。

rows.pali: Yathāha –
rows.english: according as it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 同一无色界善业已经造作并积集，超越一切色想后，空无边处等相应的异熟识生起。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: "Tasseva arūpāvacarassa kusalassa kammassa kaṭattā upacitattā vipākaṃ sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāsahagataṃ - pe - viññāṇañcā - pe - ākiñcaññā - pe - nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasahagataṃ sukhassa ca dukkhassa ca pahānā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī"ti (dha. sa. 501).
rows.english: “Owing to that same profitable kamma of the immaterial sphere having been performed, stored up [by the development of that same profitable immaterial jhāna, with the abandoning of bodily pleasure and pain … he enters upon and dwells in the resultant fourth jhāna, which,] with the complete surmounting of perceptions of material form … is accompanied by the base consisting of boundless space” (Dhs §501), “accompanied by the base consisting of boundless consciousness” (Dhs §502), “accompanied by the base consisting of nothingness” (Dhs §503), “accompanied by the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception” (Dhs §504).
rows.chinese_translation: 其余十九种，则依各自情形在三有中既于现行也于结生中运作。

rows.pali: 621.Evaṃ yaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā yaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti, taṃ ñatvā idānissa evaṃ pavatti veditabbā – sabbameva hi idaṃ pavattipaṭisandhivasena dvedhā pavattati.
rows.english: 126. After knowing what kind of consciousness has what formations as its condition, one should now understand how it occurs as follows. Now, this resultant consciousness all occurs in two ways, namely, (a) in the course of an individual existence (or continuity), and (b) at the rebirth-linking [moment].
rows.chinese_translation: 怎样运作？

rows.pali: Tattha dve pañcaviññāṇāni, dve manodhātuyo, somanassasahagatā ahetukamanoviññāṇadhātūti imāni terasa pañcavokārabhave pavattiyaññeva pavattanti.
rows.english: Herein, there are the two fivefold consciousnesses ((34)–(38) and (50)–(54)), two mind elements ((39) and (55)), and root-causeless mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy (40), that is, thirteen which occur only in the course of an existence in the five-constituent kind of becoming.20
rows.note: 20. For five-constituent becoming, etc., see §§253–54. cf. §180.
rows.chinese_translation: 先说五种善异熟眼等识：相应根成熟时，适宜或适宜中性的所缘进入眼等门，并依次由善异熟或不善异熟产生。

rows.pali: Sesāni ekūnavīsati tīsu bhavesu yathānurūpaṃ pavattiyampi paṭisandhiyampi pavattanti.
rows.english: The remaining nineteen occur in the three kinds of becoming, either in the course of an existence or at rebirth-linking, as appropriate.
rows.chinese_translation: 五种不善异熟识也同样如此。

rows.pali: Kathaṃ?
rows.english: How?
rows.chinese_translation: 只是它们的所缘是不适宜或不适宜中性的；这就是差别。

rows.pali: Kusalavipākāni tāva cakkhuviññāṇādīni pañca kusalavipākena akusalavipākena vā nibbattassa yathākkamaṃ paripākaṃ upagatindriyassa cakkhādīnaṃ āpāthagataṃ iṭṭhaṃ iṭṭhamajjhattaṃ vā rūpādiārammaṇaṃ ārabbha cakkhādipasādaṃ nissāya dassanasavanaghāyanasāyanaphusanakiccaṃ sādhayamānāni pavattanti.
rows.english: 127. Firstly, in one who has been reborn by means of either profitable-result or unprofitable result: according as his faculties mature, so the five profitable- resultant eye-, etc., consciousnesses occur accomplishing the respective functions of seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, and touching ((d)–(h)), contingent respectively upon a desirable or desirable-neutral visible datum, etc., as object that has come into the focus of the eye, etc., and having the sensitivity of the eye, etc., as [material] support.
rows.chinese_translation: 这十种识的门、所缘、所依处和作用都确定。

rows.pali: Tathā akusalavipākāni pañca.
rows.english: And likewise the five unprofitable-resultant consciousnesses;
rows.chinese_translation: 五种不善异熟识也同样如此。

rows.pali: Kevalañhi tesaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ aniṭṭhamajjhattaṃ vā ārammaṇaṃ hoti.
rows.english: that the visible data, etc., as object for these are undesirable or undesirable-neutral.
rows.chinese_translation: 只是它们的所缘是不适宜或不适宜中性的，这就是差别。

rows.pali: Ayameva viseso.
rows.english: - the only difference being this.
rows.chinese_translation: 这十种识的门、所缘、所依处和作用都确定。

rows.pali: Dasapi cetāni niyatadvārārammaṇavatthuṭṭhānāni niyatakiccāneva ca bhavanti.
rows.english: And these ten are invariable as to their door, object, physical basis, and position [in the cognitive series], and invariable as to their functions.
rows.chinese_translation: 随后，善异熟眼等识无间生起善异熟意界，缘同一所缘，依心所依处，完成领受作用。

rows.pali: Tato kusalavipākānaṃ cakkhuviññāṇādīnaṃ anantarā kusalavipākā manodhātu tesaṃyeva ārammaṇaṃ ārabbha hadayavatthuṃ nissāya sampaṭicchanakiccaṃ sādhayamānā pavattati.
rows.english: 128. After that, next to the profitable-resultant eye-, etc., consciousness, the profitable-resultant mind element (39) occurs accomplishing the function of receiving (i), contingent upon the same object as that of the former, and having the heart-basis as support. And next after the unprofitable-resultant eye-, etc., consciousness,
rows.chinese_translation: 不善异熟眼等识之后，也同样生起不善异熟意界。

rows.pali: Tathā akusalavipākānaṃ anantarā akusalavipākā.
rows.english: the unprofitable-resultant mind element (55) occurs likewise.
rows.chinese_translation: 这两种意界的门和所缘不确定，但所依处和作用确定。

rows.pali: Idañca pana dvayaṃ aniyatadvārārammaṇaṃ niyatavatthuṭṭhānaṃ niyatakiccañca hoti.
rows.english: But these two, while variable as to door and object, are invariable as to physical basis and position, and invariable as to function.
rows.chinese_translation: 这个二者的门和所缘不确定，但所依处和作用确定。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Somanassasahagatā pana ahetukamanoviññāṇadhātu kusalavipākamanodhātuyā anantarā tassā eva ārammaṇaṃ ārabbha hadayavatthuṃ nissāya santīraṇakiccaṃ sādhayamānā chasu dvāresu balavārammaṇe kāmāvacarasattānaṃ yebhuyyena lobhasampayuttajavanāvasāne bhavaṅgavīthiṃ pacchinditvā javanena gahitārammaṇe tadārammaṇavasena ca sakiṃ vā dvikkhattuṃ vā pavattatīti majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ.
rows.english: 129. Then next to the profitable-resultant mind element, the root-causeless mind-consciousness element accompanied by joy (40) occurs accomplishing the function of investigation (j), contingent upon the same object as that of the mind element, and having the heart-basis as support. And when the object is a vivid one in any of the six doors belonging to sense-sphere beings, usually at the end of impulsions associated with greed it holds up the [renewal of the] course of the life-continuum (b) by occurring either once or twice as registration (m), having the same object as that apprehended by the impulsions—so it is said in the Majjhima Commentary.21
rows.note: 21. This refers to the old Sinhalese commentary no longer extant.
rows.chinese_translation: 阿毗达磨注释书说，在彼所缘中有两个心路过程。

rows.pali: Abhidhammaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana tadārammaṇe dve cittavārā āgatā.
rows.english: But in the Abhidhamma Commentary two turns of consciousness have been handed down with respect to registration.
rows.chinese_translation: 这个心也有“彼所缘”和“后有分”两个名称。

rows.pali: Idaṃ pana cittaṃ tadārammaṇanti ca piṭṭhibhavaṅganti cāti dve nāmāni labhati.
rows.english: This consciousness has two names, “registration” (tad-ārammaṇa—lit. having that object that the preceding impulsions had) and “aftermath life-continuum” (piṭṭhi- bhavaṅga—see XIV.122).
rows.chinese_translation: 它的门和所缘不确定，所依处确定，处所和作用不确定。

rows.pali: Aniyatadvārārammaṇaṃ niyatavatthukaṃ aniyataṭṭhānakiccañca hotīti.
rows.english: It is variable as to door and object, it is invariable as to physical basis, and it is variable as to position and function.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此应知，这十三种只在五蕴有的现行中运作。

rows.pali: Evaṃ tāva terasa pañcavokārabhave pavattiyaññeva pavattantīti veditabbāni.
rows.english: This, in the first place, it should be understood, is how thirteen kinds of consciousness occur only in the course of an individual existence in the five- constituent kind of becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余十九种没有一种不在相应的结生中运作。

rows.pali: Sesesu ekūnavīsatiyā na kiñci attano anurūpāya paṭisandhiyā na pavattati.
rows.english: 130. As to the remaining nineteen ((41)–(49) and (56)–(65)), there is none that does not occur as a rebirth-linking (a) appropriate to it (see §133).
rows.chinese_translation: 其余十九种中，没有一种不在相应的结生中运作。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Pavattiyaṃ pana kusalākusalavipākā tāva dve ahetukamanoviññāṇadhātuyo pañcadvāre kusalākusalavipākamanodhātūnaṃ anantarā santīraṇakiccaṃ, chasu dvāresu pubbe vuttanayeneva tadārammaṇakiccaṃ, attanā dinnapaṭisandhito uddhaṃ asati bhavaṅgupacchedake cittuppāde bhavaṅgakiccaṃ, ante cutikiccañcāti cattāri kiccāni sādhayamānā niyatavatthukā aniyatadvārārammaṇaṭṭhānakiccā hutvā pavattanti.
rows.english: But in the course of an individual existence, firstly, two, namely, profitable-resultant and unprofitable-resultant root-causeless mind-consciousness elements ((41) and (56)) occur accomplishing four functions, that is to say, the function of investigating in the five doors (j) next after profitable-resultant and unprofitable-resultant mind element, the function of registration (m) in the six doors in the way already stated, the function of life-continuum (b) that continues after rebirth-linking given by themselves, as long as there is no thought-arising to interrupt the life- continuum, and lastly the function of death (n) at the end [of the course of an existence]. And so these two are invariable as to [possession of heart-] basis, and variable as to door, object, position, and function.
rows.chinese_translation: 八种有因欲界心，依前述方式在六门中完成彼所缘作用；从它们所给予的结生之后，只要没有造成有分中断的心生起，就完成有分作用。

rows.pali: Aṭṭha kāmāvacarasahetukacittāni vuttanayeneva chasu dvāresu tadārammaṇakiccaṃ, attanā dinnapaṭisandhito uddhaṃ asati bhavaṅgupacchedake cittuppāde bhavaṅgakiccaṃ, ante cutikiccañcāti tīṇi kiccāni sādhayamānāni niyatavatthukāni aniyatadvārārammaṇaṭṭhānakiccāni hutvā pavattanti.
rows.english: 131. The eight sense-sphere consciousnesses with root-cause ((42)–(49)) occur accomplishing three functions, namely, the function of registration (m) in the six doors in the way already stated, the function of life-continuum (b) after rebirth- linking given by themselves, as long as there is no thought-arising to interrupt the life-continuum, and lastly the function of death (n) at the end. And they are invariable as to [possession of heart-] basis, and variable as to door, position, and function.
rows.chinese_translation: 五种色界心和四种无色界心，在各自给予结生后，只要没有有分中断，就完成有分作用，最后完成死亡作用。

rows.pali: Pañca rūpāvacarāni cattāri ca āruppāni attanā dinnapaṭisandhito uddhaṃ asati bhavaṅgupacchedake cittuppāde bhavaṅgakiccaṃ, ante cutikiccañcāti kiccadvayaṃ sādhayamānāni pavattanti.
rows.english: 132. The five fine-material consciousnesses ((57)–(61)) and the four immaterial consciousnesses ((62)–(65)) occur accomplishing two functions, namely, the function of life-continuum (b) that continues after rebirth-linking given by themselves, as long as there is no thought-arising to interrupt the life-continuum, and the function of death (n) at the end.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中色界心的所依和所缘确定，但处所和作用不确定；其余心的所依和所缘确定，而处所和作用不确定。

rows.pali: Tesu rūpāvacarāni niyatavatthārammaṇāni aniyataṭṭhānakiccāni, itarāni niyatavatthukāni niyatārammaṇāni aniyataṭṭhānakiccāni hutvā pavattantīti evaṃ tāva bāttiṃsavidhampi viññāṇaṃ pavattiyaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā pavattati.
rows.english: As regards these, those of the fine- material sphere are invariable as to [possession of heart-]basis and as to their object, and they are variable as to position and function, while the others occur invariably without [heart-] basis, and they are invariable as to object, and variable as to position and function. This, in the first place, is how the thirty-twofold resultant consciousness occurs in the course of an individual existence with formations as condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 如此，三十二种世间异熟识的运作应先这样理解。

rows.pali: Tatrāssa te te saṅkhārā kammapaccayena ca upanissayapaccayena ca paccayā honti.
rows.english: And there [in the course of an existence] these several formations are conditions, as kamma condition and decisive-support condition, for this [thirty-twofold resultant consciousness].
rows.chinese_translation: 其中相应的行，以业缘和亲依止缘成为它们的缘。

rows.pali: 622.Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ "sesesu ekūnavīsatiyā na kiñci attano anurūpāya paṭisandhiyā na pavattatī"ti, taṃ atisaṃkhittattā dubbijānaṃ.
rows.english: 133. But what was said above, namely, “as to the remaining nineteen, there is none that does not occur as a rebirth-linking appropriate to it” (§130), is hard to understand since it is too brief.
rows.chinese_translation: 有人说其余十九种都在相应结生中运作，但这句话过于简略，难以理解。

rows.pali: Tenassa vitthāranayadassanatthaṃ vuccati – kati paṭisandhiyo, kati paṭisandhicittāni, kena kattha paṭisandhi hoti, kiṃ paṭisandhiyā ārammaṇanti?
rows.english: Hence, in order to show the details it may be asked: (i) How many kinds of rebirth-linking are there? (ii) How many kinds of rebirth- linking consciousness? (iii) Where and by what means does rebirth-linking come about? (iv) What does rebirth-linking [consciousness] have as its object?
rows.chinese_translation: 因此为说明详细方法，提出这些问题：有多少种结生、多少种结生心、由什么在何处结生、结生的所缘是什么？

rows.pali: Asaññapaṭisandhiyā saddhiṃ vīsati paṭisandhiyo.
rows.english: 134. (i) Including the rebirth-linking of non-percipient beings there are twenty kinds of rebirth-linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 连同无想结生在内，共有二十种结生。

rows.pali: Vuttappakārāneva ekūnavīsati paṭisandhicittāni.
rows.english: (ii) There are nineteen kinds of rebirth-linking consciousnesses, as already described.
rows.chinese_translation: 结生心就是前面所说的十九种。

rows.pali: Tattha akusalavipākāya ahetukamanoviññāṇadhātuyā apāyesu paṭisandhi hoti.
rows.english: (iii) Herein, rebirth-linking by means of the unprofitable-resultant root- causeless mind-consciousness element (56) comes about in the states of loss.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，不善异熟的无因意识界在恶趣中结生。

rows.pali: Kusalavipākāya manussaloke jaccandhajātibadhirajātiummattakajātieḷamūganapuṃsakādīnaṃ.
rows.english: Rebirth-linking by means of the profitable-resultant (41) comes about in the human world among those blind from birth, born deaf, born mad, born drivelling (see M I 20; M-a I 118), the sexless, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 善异熟意识界在人间为生来失明、先天耳聋、痴狂、哑或无根等人结生。

rows.pali: Aṭṭhahi sahetukakāmāvacaravipākehi kāmāvacaradevesu ceva manussesu ca puññavantānaṃ paṭisandhi hoti.
rows.english: Rebirth-linking by means of the eight principal resultant consciousnesses with root-cause ((42)–(49)) comes about among deities of the sense sphere and the meritorious among men.
rows.chinese_translation: 八种有因欲界异熟心，在欲界诸天以及人间有福者中结生。

rows.pali: Pañcahi rūpāvacaravipākehi rūpībrahmaloke.
rows.english: That by means of the five fine-material resultant kinds comes about in the fine-material Brahmā-world.
rows.chinese_translation: 五种色界异熟心，在色界梵天中结生。

rows.pali: Catūhi arūpāvacaravipākehi arūpaloketi.
rows.english: That by means of the four immaterial-sphere resultant kinds comes about in the immaterial world.
rows.chinese_translation: 四种无色界异熟心，在无色界中结生。

rows.pali: Yena ca yattha paṭisandhi hoti, sā eva tassa anurūpā paṭisandhi nāma.
rows.english: So rebirth-linking [consciousness] conforms to the means by which, and the place in which, it comes about.
rows.chinese_translation: 由什么心、在何处结生，该结生就是与它相应的结生。

rows.pali: Saṅkhepato pana paṭisandhiyā tīṇi ārammaṇāni honti atītaṃ paccuppannaṃ navattabbañca.
rows.english: (iv) Briefly, rebirth-linking [consciousness] has three kinds of objects, namely, past, present, and not-so-classifiable (see Ch. III, n. 32).
rows.chinese_translation: 简言之，结生有三种所缘：过去、现在和不可说。

rows.pali: Asaññā paṭisandhi anārammaṇāti.
rows.english: Non-percipient rebirth- linking [consciousness] has no object.
rows.chinese_translation: 无想结生没有所缘。

rows.pali: Tattha viññāṇañcāyatananevasaññānāsaññāyatanapaṭisandhīnaṃ atītameva ārammaṇaṃ.
rows.english: 135. Herein, in the base consisting of boundless consciousness and the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception, the object of rebirth-linking is past.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，空无边处和非想非非想处的结生，所缘只有过去。

rows.pali: Dasannaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ atītaṃ vā paccuppannaṃ vā.
rows.english: That of the ten kinds of sense-sphere rebirth-linking is past or present.
rows.chinese_translation: 十种欲界结生的所缘可以是过去，也可以是现在。

rows.pali: Sesānaṃ navattabbameva.
rows.english: That of the rest is not-so-classifiable.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余结生的所缘只能是不可说。

rows.pali: Evaṃ tīsu ārammaṇesu pavattamānā pana paṭisandhi yasmā atītārammaṇassa vā navattabbārammaṇassa vā cuticittassa anantarameva pavattati.
rows.english: But while the rebirth-linking consciousness occurs thus with three kinds of objects, the death consciousness, next to which it occurs, has only a past or a not-so-classifiable object,
rows.chinese_translation: 虽然结生可在三种所缘中运作，但它紧接着过去所缘或不可说所缘的死亡心而生起。

rows.pali: Paccuppannārammaṇaṃ pana cuticittaṃ nāma natthi.
rows.english: there being no death consciousness with a present object.
rows.chinese_translation: 并没有以现在为所缘的死亡心。

rows.pali: Tasmā dvīsu ārammaṇesu aññatarārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā tīsu ārammaṇesu aññatarārammaṇāya paṭisandhiyā sugatiduggativasena pavattanākāro veditabbo.
rows.english: Consequently, it should be understood how it occurs in the happy destinies and the unhappy destinies as follows, that is to say, how rebirth-linking consciousness with one of three kinds of objects occurs next to death consciousness with one of two kinds of objects.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，应知结生和死亡依两种所缘中的一种而运作，且结生依三种所缘中的一种，分别有善趣和恶趣的情形。

rows.pali: 623.Seyyathidaṃ – kāmāvacarasugatiyaṃ tāva ṭhitassa pāpakammino puggalassa "tānissa tasmiṃ samaye olambantī"tiādivacanato (ma. ni. 3.248) maraṇamañce nipannassa yathūpacitaṃ pāpakammaṃ vā kammanimittaṃ vā manodvāre āpāthamāgacchati.
rows.english: 136.[From happy to unhappy destiny.] For example, firstly in the case of a person in the happy destinies of the sense-sphere who is an evildoer, when he is lying on his deathbed, his evil kamma according as it has been stored up, or its sign, comes into focus in the mind door. For it is said, “Then [the evil deeds that he did in the past] … cover him [and overspread him and envelop him]” (M III 164), and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 例如，先说住在欲界善趣而造作恶业的人；依据经中“那些恶业在那时悬挂着”等说法，他躺在死亡床上时，按已积集的恶业显现相应的恶相。

rows.pali: Taṃ ārabbha uppannāya tadārammaṇapariyosānāya javanavīthiyā anantaraṃ bhavaṅgavisayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā cuticittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: Then next to the cognitive series of impulsions ending in registration22 that arose contingent upon that [kamma or its sign], death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
rows.note: 22.Vibh-a (Be) adds “suddhāya va javanavīthiyā” here, as in §140 below in all texts.
rows.chinese_translation: 以那个所缘生起的心路过程结束于彼所缘之后，死亡心便以有分的所缘为所缘而生起。

rows.pali: Tasmiṃ niruddhe tadeva āpāthagataṃ kammaṃ vā kammanimittaṃ vā ārabbha anupacchinnakilesabalavināmitaṃ duggatipariyāpannaṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: When it has ceased, rebirth- linking consciousness arises contingent upon that same kamma or kamma sign that had come into focus, and it does so located in the unhappy destiny, being driven there by the force of defilements that have not been cut off.
rows.chinese_translation: 死亡心灭后，正是那个在门中出现的业或业相，牵引着烦恼力量未断的人，属于恶趣的结生心便生起。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā atītārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a past object and comes next to death consciousness with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是紧接过去所缘死亡心之后生起过去所缘结生的情形。

rows.pali: Aparassa maraṇasamaye vuttappakārakammavasena narakādīsu aggijālavaṇṇādikaṃ duggatinimittaṃ manodvāre āpāthamāgacchati, tassa dvikkhattuṃ bhavaṅge uppajjitvā niruddhe taṃ ārammaṇaṃ ārabbha ekaṃ āvajjanaṃ, maraṇassa āsannabhāvena mandībhūtavegattā pañca javanāni, dve tadārammaṇānīti tīṇi vīthicittāni uppajjanti.
rows.english: 137.In another’s case, owing to kamma of the kind already described, there comes into focus at the mind door at the time of death the sign of the unhappy destinies with the appearance of fire and flames, etc., in the hells, and so on. 23 So when the life-continuum has twice arisen and ceased, three sorts of cognitive- series consciousness arise contingent upon that object, namely, the one adverting, impulsions numbering five because of the slowing down due to the nearness of death, and two registrations.
rows.chinese_translation: 另一个人在临终时，由前述业力，地狱等处火焰颜色等恶趣相在意门中出现；该相在有分中出现两次并灭去后，便以它为所缘生起五个速行和两个彼所缘心。

rows.pali: Tato bhavaṅgavisayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā ekaṃ cuticittaṃ.
rows.english: After that, one death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
rows.chinese_translation: 随后以有分的所缘为所缘，生起一个死亡心。

rows.pali: Ettāvatā ekādasa cittakkhaṇā atītā honti.
rows.english: At this point eleven consciousnesses have elapsed.
rows.chinese_translation: 到此已经过去了十一个心刹那。

rows.pali: Athassa avasesapañcacittakkhaṇāyuke tasmiññeva ārammaṇe paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: Then, having that same object, which has a life span of the remaining five conscious moments, his rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
rows.chinese_translation: 此后，在他只剩五个心刹那寿命时，结生心以同一所缘生起。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā paccuppannārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a present object and comes next to death with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是以过去为所缘的死亡心之后，生起以现在为所缘结生的情形。

rows.pali: Aparassa maraṇasamaye pañcannaṃ dvārānaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rāgādihetubhūtaṃ hīnamārammaṇaṃ āpāthamāgacchati.
rows.english: 138. In another’s case, at the time of death there comes into focus in one of the five doors an inferior object that is a cause of greed, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 另一个人在临终时，五门中的某一门出现了以贪等为因的低劣所缘。

rows.pali: Tassa yathākkamena uppanne voṭṭhabbanāvasāne maraṇassa āsannabhāvena mandībhūtavegattā pañca javanāni, dve tadārammaṇāni ca uppajjanti.
rows.english: When a series of consciousnesses up to determining have arisen in due succession, there arise impulsions numbering five because of slowing down due to the nearness of death, and two registrations.
rows.chinese_translation: 依次生起确定心后，由于接近死亡、心力减弱，只生起五个速行和两个彼所缘心。

rows.pali: Tato bhavaṅgavisayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā ekaṃ cuticittaṃ.
rows.english: After that, one death consciousness arises making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
rows.chinese_translation: 随后以有分的所缘为所缘，生起一个死亡心。

rows.pali: Ettāvatā ca dve bhavaṅgāni, āvajjanaṃ, dassanaṃ, sampaṭicchanaṃ, santīraṇaṃ, voṭṭhabbanaṃ, pañca javanāni, dve tadārammaṇāni, ekaṃ cuticittanti pañcadasa cittakkhaṇā atītā honti.
rows.english: At this point fifteen consciousnesses have elapsed, namely, two life-continuums, one each adverting, seeing, receiving, investigating and determining, five impulsions, two registrations, and one death consciousness.
rows.chinese_translation: 到此为止，有分、转向、看见、领受、审查、确定、五个速行、两个彼所缘和一个死亡心，共十五个心刹那已经过去。

rows.pali: Athāvasesaekacittakkhaṇāyuke tasmiññeva ārammaṇe paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: Then, having that same object, which has a life span of the remaining one conscious moment, his rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
rows.chinese_translation: 随后，在只剩一个心刹那寿命时，结生心以同一所缘生起。

rows.pali: Ayampi atītārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā paccuppannārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This also is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a present object and comes next to a death consciousness with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这也是以过去所缘死亡心之后，生起现在所缘结生的情形。

rows.pali: Esa tāva atītārammaṇāya sugaticutiyā anantarā atītapaccuppannārammaṇāya duggatipaṭisandhiyā pavattanākāro.
rows.english: This, firstly, is how rebirth-linking in an unhappy destiny with past and present objects occurs next to death consciousness in a happy destiny with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 以上是以过去所缘的善趣死亡之后，生起以过去或现在为所缘的恶趣结生的运作方式。

rows.pali: 624.Duggatiyaṃ ṭhitassa pana upacitānavajjakammassa vuttanayeneva taṃ anavajjakammaṃ vā kammanimittaṃ vā manodvāre āpāthamāgacchatīti kaṇhapakkhe sukkapakkhaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbaṃ purimanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: 139.[From unhappy to happy destiny.] In the case of one in an unhappy destiny who has stored up blameless kamma all should be understood in the same way, substituting the bright for the dark side thus: His good kamma, [according as it has been stored up], or its sign, comes into focus in the mind door [and continuing] in the way already stated.
rows.chinese_translation: 住在恶趣的人，如果积集了无罪业，依照前述相反的方式，该无罪业或业相在意门出现；除去黑白次第，其他都与前面相同。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītārammaṇāya duggaticutiyā anantarā atītapaccuppannārammaṇāya sugatipaṭisandhiyā pavattanākāro.
rows.english: This is how rebirth-linking occurs in a happy destiny with past and present objects next to death consciousness in an unhappy destiny with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是以过去所缘恶趣死亡之后，生起以过去或现在为所缘善趣结生的运作方式。

rows.pali: 625.Sugatiyaṃ ṭhitassa pana upacitānavajjakammassa "tānissa tasmiṃ samaye olambantī"tiādivacanato maraṇamañce nipannassa yathūpacitaṃ anavajjakammaṃ vā kammanimittaṃ vā manodvāre āpāthamāgacchati.
rows.english: 140.[From happy to happy destiny.] In the case of one in a happy destiny who has stored up blameless kamma, when he is lying on his death-bed, his blameless kamma according as it has been stored up, or its sign, comes into focus in the mind door. For it is said, “Then [the good deeds he did in the past] … cover him [and overspread him and envelop him]” (M III 171), and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 住在善趣的人，如果积集了无罪业，依经中“那些业在当时悬挂着”等说法，临终时相应的无罪业或业相在意门出现。

rows.pali: Tañca kho upacitakāmāvacarānavajjakammasseva.
rows.english: And that applies only in the case of one who has stored up blameless sense-sphere kamma.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里所说的只是积集的欲界无罪业。

rows.pali: Upacitamahaggatakammassa pana kammanimittameva āpāthamāgacchati.
rows.english: But in the case of one who has stored up kamma of the exalted spheres only the sign of the kamma comes into focus.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果积集的是广大业，出现的只有业相。

rows.pali: Taṃ ārabbha uppannāya tadārammaṇapariyosānāya suddhāya vā javanavīthiyā anantaraṃ bhavaṅgavisayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā cuticittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: Then next to the cognitive series of impulsions ending in registration, or of simple impulsions, that arose contingent upon that [kamma or its sign], death consciousness arises making the life- continuum’s objective field its object.
rows.chinese_translation: 缘此生起以彼所缘结束的清净心路过程，随后以有分所缘为所缘生起死亡心。

rows.pali: Tasmiṃ niruddhe tameva āpāthagataṃ kammaṃ vā kammanimittaṃ vā ārabbha anupacchinnakilesabalavināmitaṃ sugatipariyāpannaṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: When it has ceased, rebirth-linking consciousness arises contingent upon that same kamma or sign of kamma that had come into focus, and it does so located in the happy destiny, being driven there by the force of defilements that have not been cut off.
rows.chinese_translation: 死亡心灭后，以同一出现的业或业相为所缘，烦恼力量未断而属于善趣的结生心便生起。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā atītārammaṇā vā navattabbārammaṇā vā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a past or a not-so-classifiable object and comes next to death consciousness with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是过去所缘死亡之后，生起以过去或不可说所缘为所缘结生的情形。

rows.pali: Aparassa maraṇasamaye kāmāvacaraanavajjakammavasena manussaloke mātukucchivaṇṇasaṅkhātaṃ vā devaloke uyyānavimānakapparukkhādivaṇṇasaṅkhātaṃ vā sugatinimittaṃ manodvāre āpāthamāgacchati, tassa duggatinimitte dassitānukkameneva cuticittānantaraṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: 141.In another’s case, owing to blameless sense-sphere kamma, there comes into focus in the mind door at the time of death the sign of a happy destiny, in other words, the appearance of the mother’s womb24 in the case of the human world or the appearance of pleasure groves, divine palaces, wishing trees, etc., in the case of the divine world. His rebirth-linking consciousness arises next to the death consciousness in the order shown for the sign of an unhappy destiny.
rows.note: 24. The Sammohavinodanī adds more details here: “When hell appears it does so like a metal cauldron; when the human world appears, the mothe...
rows.chinese_translation: 另一个人在临终时，由欲界无罪业，善趣相在意门出现：在人间是母胎颜色，在天界是园林、宫殿或如意树等颜色。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā paccuppannārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This is the kind of rebirth-linking that has a present object and comes next to death consciousness with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是过去所缘死亡之后，生起现在所缘结生的情形。

rows.pali: Aparassa maraṇasamaye ñātakā "ayaṃ tāta tavatthāya buddhapūjā karīyati cittaṃ pasādehī"ti vatvā pupphadāmapaṭākādivasena rūpārammaṇaṃ vā, dhammassavanatūriyapūjādivasena saddārammaṇaṃ vā, dhūmavāsagandhādivasena gandhārammaṇaṃ vā, "idaṃ tāta sāyassu tavatthāya dātabbadeyyadhamma"nti vatvā madhuphāṇitādivasena rasārammaṇaṃ vā, "idaṃ tāta phusassu tavatthāya dātabbadeyyadhamma"nti vatvā cīnapaṭṭasomārapaṭṭādivasena phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā pañcadvāre upasaṃharanti, tassa tasmiṃ āpāthagate rūpādiārammaṇe yathākkamena uppannavoṭṭhabbanāvasāne maraṇassa āsannabhāvena mandībhūtavegattā pañca javanāni, dve tadārammaṇāni ca uppajjanti.
rows.english: 142. In another’s case, relatives present [objects to him] at the five sense doors, such as a visible datum as object, perhaps flowers, garlands, flags, banners, etc., saying, “This is being offered to the Blessed One for your sake, dear, set your mind at rest”; or a sound as object, perhaps, preaching of the Dhamma, offerings of music, etc.; or an odour as object, perhaps incense, scents, perfumes, etc.; or a taste as object, perhaps honey, molasses, etc., saying, “Taste this, dear, it is a gift to be given for your sake”; or a tangible datum as object, perhaps Chinese silk, silk of Somāra, saying, “Touch this, dear, it is a gift to be given for your sake. ” Now, when that visible datum, or whatever it may be, as object has come into focus for him and the consciousnesses ending in determining have arisen in due succession, there arise in him impulsions numbering five because of slowing down due to the nearness of death, and two registrations;
rows.chinese_translation: 另一个人临终时，亲属说“亲爱的，这是为你供养佛而作，请生起净信”，并以花鬘、旗幡等色为所缘，或以听法、奏乐、供养等声为所缘。

rows.pali: Tato bhavaṅgavisayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā ekaṃ cuticittaṃ, tadavasāne tasmiññeva ekacittakkhaṇaṭṭhitike ārammaṇe paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: after that, one death consciousness, making the life-continuum’s objective field its object. At the end of that, having that same object, which lasts only a single conscious moment, rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
rows.chinese_translation: 随后以有分所缘为所缘生起一个死亡心；它结束时，就在同一只维持一个心刹那的所缘上生起结生心。

rows.pali: Ayampi atītārammaṇāya cutiyā anantarā paccuppannārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This also is the kind of rebirth-linking with a present object and comes next to a death consciousness with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这也是过去所缘死亡之后，生起现在所缘结生的情形。

rows.pali: 626.Aparassa pana pathavīkasiṇajjhānādivasena paṭiladdhamahaggatassa sugatiyaṃ ṭhitassa maraṇasamaye kāmāvacarakusalakamma-kammanimitta-gatinimittānaṃ vā aññataraṃ, pathavīkasiṇādikaṃ vā nimittaṃ, mahaggatacittaṃ vā manodvāre āpāthamāgacchati, cakkhusotānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ kusaluppattihetubhūtaṃ paṇītamārammaṇaṃ āpāthamāgacchati, tassa yathākkamena uppannavoṭṭhabbanāvasāne maraṇassa āsannabhāvena mandībhūtavegattā pañca javanāni uppajjanti.
rows.english: 143. But in the case of another who is in a happy destiny and has obtained exalted [consciousness] through earth-kasiṇa jhāna, etc., at the time of his death there comes into focus at the mind door the sense-sphere profitable kamma or the sign of the kamma or the sign of the destiny, or else the sign of the earth kasiṇa, etc., or else the exalted consciousness, or else there comes into focus a superior object of the eye or ear that is a cause for profitable rebirth. When the consciousnesses ending in determining have arisen in due succession, there arise in him impulsions numbering five because of slowing down due to the nearness of death.
rows.chinese_translation: 另一个住在善趣、依地遍等获得广大禅的人临终时，欲界善业、业相或趣相中的一种，或地遍等广大所缘中的一种，在意门出现。

rows.pali: Mahaggatagatikānaṃ pana tadārammaṇaṃ natthi, tasmā javanānantaraṃyeva bhavaṅgavisayaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā ekaṃ cuticittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: But in those who belong to an exalted destiny there is no registration. So the one death consciousness arises next to the impulsion and making the life-continuum’s objective field its object.
rows.chinese_translation: 广大趣的人没有彼所缘，所以速行之后便以有分所缘为所缘生起死亡心。

rows.pali: Tassāvasāne kāmāvacaramahaggatasugatīnaṃ aññatarasugatipariyāpannaṃ yathūpaṭṭhitesu ārammaṇesu aññatarārammaṇaṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: At the end of that, rebirth- linking consciousness arises located in one of the happy destinies of the sense sphere or exalted sphere, and having as its object whichever one among the aforesaid objects has appeared.
rows.chinese_translation: 死亡心结束时，结生心在欲界广大善趣之一中，以出现的所缘之一为所缘而生起。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ navattabbārammaṇāya sugaticutiyā anantarā atītapaccuppannanavattabbārammaṇānaṃ aññatarārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: This is the kind of rebirth-linking with a past, present, or not-so-classifiable object next to death consciousness in a happy destiny with a not-so-classifiable object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是不可说所缘的善趣死亡之后，结生以过去、现在或不可说所缘之一为所缘的情形。

rows.pali: Etenānusārena āruppacutiyāpi anantarā paṭisandhi veditabbā.
rows.english: 144. Rebirth-linking next to immaterial-sphere death should be understood in this way too.
rows.chinese_translation: 无色界死亡之后的结生，也应依此类推理解。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītanavattabbārammaṇāya sugaticutiyā anantarā atītanavattabbapaccuppannārammaṇāya paṭisandhiyā pavattanākāro.
rows.english: This is how rebirth-linking occurs with a past, present, or not-so- classifiable object next to death consciousness in a happy destiny with a past or not-so-classifiable object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是以过去或不可说所缘的善趣死亡之后，结生以过去、不可说或现在所缘之一为所缘的运作方式。

rows.pali: 627.Duggatiyaṃ ṭhitassa pana pāpakammino vuttanayeneva taṃ kammaṃ kammanimittaṃ gatinimittaṃ vā manodvāre.
rows.english: 145.[From unhappy to unhappy destiny.] In the case of one in an unhappy destiny who is an evil-doer, that kamma, or its sign, or the sign of the destiny, comes into focus in the mind door,
rows.chinese_translation: 住在恶趣而造恶业的人，也依前述方法，其业、业相或趣相在意门出现。

rows.pali: Pañcadvāre vā pana akusaluppatti hetubhūtaṃ ārammaṇaṃ āpāthamāgacchati, athassa yathākkamena cuticittāvasāne duggatipariyāpannaṃ tesu ārammaṇesu aññatarārammaṇaṃ paṭisandhicittaṃ uppajjati.
rows.english: or in the five doors, as the object that is the cause for the unprofitable rebirth. Then his rebirth-linking consciousness arises in due succession at the end of the death consciousness and located in the unhappy destiny and with one of those objects as its object.
rows.chinese_translation: 或者，五门中出现成为不善生起原因的所缘；随后死亡心依次结束，结生心便以其中一种所缘而生起，属于恶趣。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ atītārammaṇāya duggaticutiyā anantarā atītapaccuppannārammaṇāya paṭisandhiyā pavattanākāroti.
rows.english: This is how rebirth-linking occurs with a past or present object next to death in an unhappy destiny with a past object.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是过去所缘恶趣死亡之后，结生以过去或现在所缘为所缘的运作方式。

rows.pali: Ettāvatā ekūnavīsatividhassāpi viññāṇassa paṭisandhivasena pavatti dīpitā hoti.
rows.english: 146.Up to this point there has been shown the occurrence of the nineteenfold consciousness as rebirth-linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 到这里，已经说明了十九种识以结生方式运作的情形。

rows.pali: 628.Tayidaṃ sabbampi evaṃ,
rows.english: Also all this [is further classified; for]
rows.chinese_translation: 这一切如此运作时，在结生方面依业分为两类；依混杂等差别，分为两类等多种。

rows.pali: Pavattamānaṃ sandhimhi, dvedhā kammena vattati;
rows.english: While it occurs in linking thus, It has a double class beside
rows.chinese_translation: 这十九种异熟识在结生时运作，依业分为两类。

rows.pali: Missādīhi ca bhedehi, bhedassa duvidhādiko.
rows.english: Through kamma, and as mixed and not, And is still further classified.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为各自的生业，以不同刹那的业缘和亲依止缘成为其缘。

rows.pali: Idañhi ekūnavīsatividhampi vipākaviññāṇaṃ paṭisandhimhi pavattamānā dvedhā kammena vattati.
rows.english: 147. When this nineteenfold kamma-resultant consciousness occurs thus in rebirth-linking, it does so by means of kamma in two ways;
rows.chinese_translation: 这十九种异熟识在结生时运作，依业分为两类。

rows.pali: Yathāsakañhi ekassa janakakammaṃ nānākkhaṇikakammapaccayena ceva upanissayapaccayena ca paccayo hoti.
rows.english: for according to the way in which the kamma that generates it occurs, the kamma can be its condition both as kamma condition acting from a different time and as decisive-support condition,
rows.chinese_translation: 各自的生业，以不同刹那的业缘和亲依止缘成为其缘。

rows.pali: Vuttañhetaṃ "kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo"ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.423).
rows.english: since this is said: “Profitable … [and] unprofitable kamma is a condition, as decisive-support condition, for [its] result” (Paṭṭh I 167, 169).
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说，善不善业以亲依止缘成为异熟的缘。

rows.pali: Evaṃ vattamānassa panassa missādīhi bhedehi duvidhādikopi bhedo veditabbo.
rows.english: 148. It should be understood that when it occurs thus, its double class, etc., is mixed and not, and it is still further classified.
rows.chinese_translation: 如此运作时，依混杂等差别，还应知有二类、三类等差别。

rows.pali: Seyyathidaṃ – idañhi paṭisandhivasena ekadhā pavattamānampi rūpena saha missāmissabhedato duvidhaṃ.
rows.english: For example: though this [type of consciousness] occurs in one way only as rebirth-linking, still it is twofold as divided into mixed and unmixed with materiality;
rows.chinese_translation: 例如，这些识虽然就结生而言是一类，但按是否与色法混杂分为两类。

rows.pali: Kāmarūpārūpabhavabhedato tividhaṃ.
rows.english: it is threefold as divided according to sense-desire, fine-material, and immaterial becoming (M I 50);
rows.chinese_translation: 按欲有、色有和无色有分为三类。

rows.pali: Aṇḍajajalābuja-saṃsedaja-opapātikayonivasena catubbidhaṃ.
rows.english: it is fourfold as egg-born, womb-born, putrescence- (moisture-) born, and of apparitional generation (M I 73);
rows.chinese_translation: 按卵生、胎生、湿生和化生分为四类。

rows.pali: Gativasena pañcavidhaṃ.
rows.english: it is fivefold according to destiny (M I 73);
rows.chinese_translation: 按趣分为五类。

rows.pali: Viññāṇaṭṭhitivasena sattavidhaṃ.
rows.english: it is sevenfold according to the stations of consciousness (D III 253),
rows.chinese_translation: 按识住分为七类。

rows.pali: Sattāvāsavasena aṭṭhavidhaṃ hoti.
rows.english: and it is eightfold according to the abodes of beings [excluding non-percipient beings] (see D III 263).
rows.chinese_translation: 按有情居分为八类。

rows.pali: 629.Tattha,
rows.english: 149. Herein:
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，混杂分为两种，因状态差别；自性也在其中分为两种；两个或三个十法聚，最少从最初算起。

rows.pali: Missaṃ dvidhā bhāvabhedā, sabhāvaṃ tattha ca dvidhā;
rows.english: The mixed is double, sexed and not, And that with sex is double too;
rows.chinese_translation: 所谓混杂分为两种，是说除无色有之外，在这里生起的与色混杂的结生识，在色有中生起时不与男女根所说的状态相伴。

rows.pali: Dve vā tayo vā dasakā, omato ādinā saha.
rows.english: The least decads the first has got Respectively are three and two.
rows.chinese_translation: 在欲有中，除非是生来性别不具足的结生，它会与性别状态相伴生起，因此分为有性和无性两种。

rows.pali: Missaṃ dvidhā bhāvabhedāti yaṃ hetaṃ ettha aññatra arūpabhavā rūpamissaṃ paṭisandhiviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, taṃ rūpabhave itthindriyapurisindriyasaṅkhātena bhāvena vinā uppattito.
rows.english: 150. The mixed is double, sexed and not: that rebirth-linking consciousness, which, leaving aside the immaterial becoming, arises here mixed with materiality, is twofold as “with sex” and “without sex,”25
rows.note: 25. Sa-bhāva (with sex) and a-bhāva (without sex) are not to be confused with sabhāva (individual essence) and abhāva (absence, non-existenc...
rows.chinese_translation: 所谓自性在其中也分为两种，是说其中具有性别状态的，又因与男女二性之一相伴生起而分为两种。

rows.pali: Kāmabhave aññatra jātipaṇḍakapaṭisandhiyā bhāvena saha uppattito sa-bhāvaṃ, a-bhāvanti duvidhaṃ hoti.
rows.english: because it arises in the fine-material sphere without the sex called femininity faculty and masculinity faculty, and because—leaving aside the rebirth-linking of one born as a eunuch—it arises in the sense-sphere becoming together with that [twofold] sex.
rows.chinese_translation: “两个或三个十法聚，最少从最初算起”，是说这里二分法中最初的色混杂、色不混杂结生识，配合所依十法聚和身十法聚，成为两个；有性者再加性根十法聚，成为三个。

rows.pali: Sabhāvaṃtattha ca dvidhāti tatthāpi ca yaṃ sa-bhāvaṃ, taṃ itthipurisabhāvānaṃ aññatarena saha uppattito duvidhameva hoti.
rows.english: And that with sex is double too: there also that with sex is twofold because it arises in association with either the female or the male sex.
rows.chinese_translation: 这种结生以最低限度生起时，在卵生和胎生两种生处中，先成为名为凝结的状态，其大小如从羊毛一根挑出的酥油精华一滴。

rows.pali: Dve vā tayo vā dasakā omato ādinā sahāti yaṃ hetamettha "missaṃ amissa"nti duke ādibhūtaṃ rūpamissaṃ paṭisandhiviññāṇaṃ, tena saha vatthukāyadasakavasena dve vā, vatthukāyabhāvadasakavasena tayo vā dasakā omato uppajjanti, natthi ito paraṃ rūpaparihānīti.
rows.english: 151. The least decads the first has got respectively are three or two: together with the rebirth-linking consciousness that is mixed with materiality and comes first in the pair “mixed and unmixed,” there arise, at the least, the two decads (see 18.5f.) of physical basis and body, or else the three decads of physical basis, body, and sex. There is no reducing the materiality below that.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里应依生处和趣来理解生起的差别。

rows.pali: Taṃ panetaṃ evaṃ omakaparimāṇaṃ uppajjamānaṃ aṇḍajajalābujanāmikāsu dvīsu yonīsu jātiuṇṇāya ekena aṃsunā uddhaṭasappimaṇḍappamāṇaṃ kalalanti laddhasaṅkhaṃ hutvā uppajjati.
rows.english: 152. But when that minimal amount arises in the two kinds of generation termed egg-born and womb-born, it amounts to no more than a drop of cream of ghee on a single fibre of new-born [kid’s] wool, and it is known as the “embryo in the first stage” (S I 206).
rows.chinese_translation: 这种最低限度的结生，在卵生和胎生两种生处中生起时，先成为凝结状态，大小如用一根出生绒毛挑出的酥油精华一滴。

rows.pali: Tattha yonīnaṃ gativasena sambhavabhedo veditabbo.
rows.english: 153. Herein, how the different kinds of generation come about may be understood according to the kind of destiny.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里应根据生处和趣来理解生起的差别。

rows.pali: 630.Etāsu hi,
rows.english: For as regards these:
rows.chinese_translation: 在这些生处中：

rows.pali: Niraye bhummavajjesu, devesu ca na yoniyo;
rows.english: No first three generations are In hell, or with the deities,
rows.chinese_translation: 地狱、除地居天以外的天界，没有生处；

rows.pali: Tisso purimikā honti, catassopi gatittaye.
rows.english: Save those of earth; all four are found In the three other destinies.
rows.chinese_translation: 三种前述生处存在于某些趣中，四种生处则存在于三趣之中。

rows.pali: Tattha devesu cāti casaddena yathā niraye ca bhummavajjesu ca devesu, evaṃ nijjhāmataṇhikapetesu ca purimikā tisso yoniyo na santīti veditabbā.
rows.english: 154. Herein, by the words with deities it should be understood that, as in hell and among deities—excepting earth deities—so also among the ghosts consumed with thirst, the first three kinds of generation are not found;
rows.chinese_translation: 这里“以及天界”中的“以及”表示：地狱、地居天、天界，以及焦渴鬼等处，都没有前三种生处。

rows.pali: Opapātikā eva hi te honti.
rows.english: for they are apparitional only.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为这些有情全都是化生。

rows.pali: Sese pana tiracchānapettivisayamanussasaṅkhāte gatittaye pubbe vajjitabhummadevesu ca catassopi yoniyo honti.
rows.english: But in the remaining three kinds of destiny, in other words, among animals, ghosts and human beings, and among the earth deities excepted above, there are all four kinds of generation.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余三趣，即畜生、饿鬼、人，以及前面排除的地居天，四种生处全都存在。

rows.pali: Tattha,
rows.chinese_translation: 其中：

rows.pali: Tiṃsa nava ceva rūpīsu, sattati ukkaṃsatotha rūpāni;
rows.english: The fine material gods have thirty-nine; The apparitional and moisture-born
rows.chinese_translation: 色界有三十九种，最高有七十种色法；

rows.pali: Saṃsedupapātayonisu, atha vā avakaṃsato tiṃsa.
rows.english: Have seventy material instances At most, and they have thirty at the least.
rows.chinese_translation: 湿生和化生处，最低则有三十种色法。

rows.pali: Rūpībrahmesu tāva opapātikayonikesu cakkhusotavatthudasakānaṃ jīvitanavakassa cāti catunnaṃ kalāpānaṃ vasena tiṃsa ca nava ca paṭisandhiviññāṇena saha rūpāni uppajjanti.
rows.english: 156.Firstly, among the fine-material Brahmās of apparitional generation there arise together with rebirth-linking consciousness thirty and also nine material instances [553] with the four groups, namely, the decads of the eye, ear, and physical basis, and the ennead of life.
rows.chinese_translation: 先说色界梵天的化生处：依眼、耳、所依十法聚和命根九法聚四类聚，连同结生识，共生起三十九种色法。

rows.pali: Rūpī brahme pana ṭhapetvā aññesu saṃsedajaopapātikayonikesu ukkaṃsato cakkhusotaghānajivhākāyavatthubhāvadasakānaṃ vasena sattati, tāni ca niccaṃ devesu.
rows.english: But leaving the fine-material Brahmās aside, among the others of apparitional generation and those of the moisture-born generation there are seventy instances of materiality at the most with the decads of the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, physical basis and sex. And these are invariably to be found among deities [of the sense sphere].
rows.chinese_translation: 除色界梵天外的湿生和化生处，最高依眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、所依和性根十法聚，共有七十种；这些在天界中恒常存在。

rows.pali: Tattha vaṇṇo gandho raso ojā catasso cāpi dhātuyo cakkhupasādo jīvitanti ayaṃ dasarūpaparimāṇo rūpapuñjo cakkhudasako nāma.
rows.english: Now, the group of material states comprising the ten material instances, namely, colour, odour, flavour, nutritive essence, and the four primary elements, with eye sensitivity and life, are called the “eye decad.”
rows.chinese_translation: 其中色、香、味、食素、四大种、眼净色和命根，共十种色法聚，称为眼十法聚。

rows.pali: Evaṃ sesā veditabbā.
rows.english: The remaining [groups of material states] should be understood in the same way.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余各项也应如此理解。

rows.pali: Avakaṃsato pana jaccandhabadhiraaghānakanapuṃsakassa jivhākāyavatthudasakānaṃ vasena tiṃsa rūpāni uppajjanti.
rows.english: 157. At the least, thirty material instances arise with the decads of the tongue, body, and physical basis, in those who are blind from birth, deaf, noseless,26 and sexless.
rows.note: 26. Vism-mhṭ (p. 611) has a long discussion here of the difficulty of speaking of the Brahmā-world (where there are only the senses of seein...
rows.chinese_translation: 最低限度时，生来失明、耳聋、无鼻、无性者，依舌、身和所依十法聚，生起三十种色法。

rows.pali: Ukkaṃsāvakaṃsānaṃ pana antare anurūpato vikappo veditabbo.
rows.english: Between the most and the least, the allotment should be understood according as appropriate.
rows.chinese_translation: 在最高和最低之间，应按相应情形作出不同组合。

rows.pali: 631.Evaṃ viditvā puna,
rows.english: 158. After knowing this, again:
rows.chinese_translation: 知道这些以后，还应进一步了解：

rows.pali: Khandhārammaṇagatihetu-vedanāpītivitakkavicārehi;
rows.english: One ought to consider the [pair] death and birth Under aggregates, object, cause, destiny, feeling, Happiness, and then thinking applied and sustained, Distinguishing them by unlikeness and likeness.
rows.chinese_translation: 应依蕴、所缘、趣、原因、受、喜、寻和伺等差别，

rows.pali: Bhedābhedaviseso, cutisandhīnaṃ pariññeyyo.
rows.chinese_translation: 辨明死亡和结生的差别与不差别。

rows.pali: Yā hesā missāmissato duvidhā paṭisandhi, yā cassā atītānantarā cuti, tāsaṃ imehi khandhādīhi bhedābhedaviseso ñātabboti attho.
rows.english: 159. The meaning is this: there is rebirth-linking that is twofold as mixed and unmixed [with materiality], and there is the death consciousness next before it, and their unlikeness and likeness according to these aggregates, etc., must be known.
rows.chinese_translation: 前述混杂与不混杂的两种结生，以及紧接其后的死亡，应根据蕴等方面的相同与不同来理解其差别。

rows.pali: Kathaṃ?
rows.english: How?
rows.chinese_translation: 怎样理解？

rows.pali: Kadāci hi catukkhandhāya āruppacutiyā anantarā catukkhandhāva ārammaṇatopi abhinnā paṭisandhi hoti.
rows.english: 160. Sometimes, next to a four-aggregate immaterial death there is a four- aggregate rebirth-linking having a like object;
rows.chinese_translation: 有时四蕴的无色界死亡之后，结生仍是四蕴，连所缘也没有差别。

rows.pali: Kadāci amahaggatabahiddhārammaṇāya mahaggataajjhattārammaṇā.
rows.english: sometimes there is an exalted rebirth-linking with an internal object next to an unexalted death with an external object.
rows.chinese_translation: 有时死亡是不广大、以外在所缘为所缘，而结生是广大、以内在所缘为所缘。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ tāva arūpabhūmīsuyeva nayo.
rows.english: This, firstly, is the method in the case of the immaterial planes.
rows.chinese_translation: 以上是只在无色界中的情形。

rows.pali: Kadāci pana catukkhandhāya arūpacutiyā anantarā pañcakkhandhā kāmāvacarapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: Sometimes there is a five-aggregate sense-sphere rebirth-linking next to a four- aggregate immaterial death.
rows.chinese_translation: 有时四蕴的无色界死亡之后，结生是五蕴的欲界结生。

rows.pali: Kadāci pañcakkhandhāya kāmāvacaracutiyā rūpāvacaracutiyā vā anantarā catukkhandhā arūpapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: Sometimes there is a four-aggregate immaterial rebirth- linking next to a five-aggregate sense-sphere death or fine-material-sphere death.
