rows.chinese_translation: 有时五蕴的欲界或色界死亡之后，结生是四蕴的无色界结生。

rows.pali: Evaṃ atītārammaṇāya cutiyā paccuppannārammaṇā paṭisandhi.
rows.english: Thus there is rebirth-linking with a present object27 next to a death with a past object,
rows.note: 27. Sammohavinodanī (Be) has “rebirth-linking with a past, not so-classifiable, and present object next to” and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 同样，过去所缘的死亡之后，可以结生为现在所缘。

rows.pali: Ekaccasugaticutiyā ekaccaduggatipaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking in a certain unhappy destiny next to death in a certain happy destiny,
rows.chinese_translation: 某些善趣死亡之后，可以结生于恶趣。

rows.pali: Ahetukacutiyā sahetukapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking with root-cause next to root- causeless death,
rows.chinese_translation: 无因死亡之后，可以结生为有因结生。

rows.pali: Duhetukacutiyā tihetukapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is triple-root-cause rebirth-linking next to double-root- cause death,
rows.chinese_translation: 二因死亡之后，可以结生为三因结生。

rows.pali: Upekkhāsahagatacutiyā somanassasahagatapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking accompanied by joy next to death accompanied by equanimity,
rows.chinese_translation: 伴随舍受的死亡之后，可以结生为伴随喜受。

rows.pali: Appītikacutiyā sappītikapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking with happiness next to death without happiness,
rows.chinese_translation: 不伴随喜的死亡之后，可以结生为伴随喜。

rows.pali: Avitakkacutiyā savitakkapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking with applied thought next to death without applied thought,
rows.chinese_translation: 不伴随寻的死亡之后，可以结生为伴随寻。

rows.pali: Avicāracutiyā savicārapaṭisandhi.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking with sustained thought next to death without sustained thought,
rows.chinese_translation: 不伴随伺的死亡之后，可以结生为伴随伺。

rows.pali: Avitakkāvicāracutiyā savitakkasavicārapaṭisandhīti tassa tassa viparītato ca yathāyogaṃ yojetabbaṃ.
rows.english: there is rebirth-linking with applied and sustained thought next to death without applied and sustained thought. In this way they can be coupled together by opposites as appropriate.
rows.chinese_translation: 不伴随寻伺的死亡之后，可以结生为同时伴随寻伺的结生；其余也应按相反情形依次配合。
获得条件的只是法，进入另一存在；

rows.pali: Laddhapaccayamiti dhammamattametaṃ bhavantaramupeti;
rows.english: 161. A mere state that has got its conditions Ushers in the ensuing existence;
rows.chinese_translation: 它并非从那里迁移，也不离开原因而存在。

rows.pali: Nāssa tato saṅkanti, na tato hetuṃ vinā hoti.
rows.english: While it does not migrate from the past, With no cause in the past it is not.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，获得条件而生起的只是色法和无色法，称为进入另一有，不是有情，也不是生命主体。

rows.pali: Iti hetaṃ laddhapaccayaṃ rūpārūpadhammamattaṃ uppajjamānaṃ bhavantaramupetīti vuccati, na satto, na jīvo.
rows.english: 162. So it is a mere material and immaterial state, arising when it has obtained its conditions, that is spoken of, saying that it comes into the next becoming; it is not a lasting being, [554] not a soul.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，所谓进入另一有，只是获得条件而生起的色法和无色法，不是有情，也不是生命主体。

rows.pali: Tassa ca nāpi atītabhavato idha saṅkanti atthi.
rows.english: And it has neither transmigrated from the past becoming
rows.chinese_translation: 它也不是从过去的有来到这里。

rows.pali: Nāpi tato hetuṃ vinā idha pātubhāvo.
rows.english: nor yet is it manifested here without cause from that.
rows.chinese_translation: 它也不是离开过去的原因而在这里出现。

rows.pali: Tayidaṃ pākaṭena manussacutipaṭisandhikkamena pakāsayissāma.
rows.english: 163. We shall explain this by the normal process of human death and rebirth- linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 现在用明显的人类死亡与结生过程来说明这一点。

rows.pali: Atītabhavasmiṃ hi sarasena upakkamena vā samāsannamaraṇassa asayhānaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgasandhibandhanacchedakānaṃ māraṇantikavedanāsatthānaṃ sannipātaṃ asahantassa ātape pakkhittaharitatālapaṇṇamiva kamena upasussamāne sarīre niruddhesu cakkhādīsu indriyesu hadayavatthumatte patiṭṭhitesu kāyindriyamanindriyajīvitindriyesu taṅkhaṇāvasesahadayavatthusannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ garukasamāsevitāsannapubbakatānaṃ aññataraṃ laddhāvasesapaccayasaṅkhārasaṅkhātaṃ kammaṃ, tadupaṭṭhāpitaṃ vā kammanimittagatinimittasaṅkhātaṃ visayaṃ ārabbha pavattati.
rows.english: When in the past becoming a man near to a natural or violent death is unable to bear the onset of the unbearable daggers of the [painful] feelings that end in death as they sever the ligatures of the joints in all the limbs, his body gradually withers like a green palm leaf lying in the glare of the sun, and when the faculties of the eye, etc., have ceased and the body faculty, mind faculty, and life faculty remain on in the heart-basis alone, then consciousness, which has as its support the heart-basis still remaining at that moment, either occurs contingent upon some kamma classed as “weighty,” “repeated,” performed “near” [to death] or previously,28 in other words, the formation that has obtained the remaining conditions, or contingent upon the objective field made to appear by that kamma, in other words, the sign of the kamma or sign of the destiny.29
rows.chinese_translation: 在过去有中，临近死亡的人承受不了自然或外力造成的死亡，遍身肢节和关节仿佛被切断，死亡终了的苦受之刀聚集起来；如同烈日下的蜡块逐渐融化。

rows.pali: Tadevaṃ pavattamānaṃ taṇhāvijjānaṃ appahīnattā avijjāpaṭicchāditādīnave tasmiṃ visaye taṇhā nāmeti, sahajātasaṅkhārā khipanti.
rows.english: And while it is occurring thus, because craving and ignorance have not been abandoned, craving pushes it and the conascent formations fling it forward30 on to that objective field, the dangers in which are concealed by ignorance.
rows.chinese_translation: 由于爱和无明尚未断除，无明遮蔽了该所缘的过患，爱便牵引它，俱生诸行将它投向前方。

rows.pali: Taṃ santativasena taṇhāya nāmiyamānaṃ saṅkhārehi khippamānaṃ orimatīrarukkhavinibaddharajjumālambitvā mātikātikkamako viya purimañca nissayaṃ jahati, aparañca kammasamuṭṭhāpitaṃ nissayaṃ assādayamānaṃ vā anassādayamānaṃ vā ārammaṇādīhiyeva paccayehi pavattatīti.
rows.english: And while, as a continuous process,31 it is being pushed by craving and flung forward by formations, it abandons its former support, like a man who crosses a river by hanging on to a rope tied to a tree on the near bank, and, whether or not it gets a further support originated by kamma, it occurs by means of the conditions consisting only in object condition, and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 它被爱依相续牵引，又被诸行推动，犹如越过水渠的人攀住此岸树上系着的绳索，舍弃原来的依处，同时获得由业生起的后续依处。

rows.pali: Ettha ca purimaṃ cavanato cuti.
rows.english: 164. The former of these [two states of consciousness] is called “death” (cuti) because of falling (cavana),
rows.chinese_translation: 这里前一者因从原有生命中死亡而称为死亡。

rows.pali: Pacchimaṃ bhavantarādipaṭisandhānato paṭisandhīti vuccati.
rows.english: and the latter is called “rebirth-linking” (paṭisandhi) because of linking (paṭisandhāna) across the gap separating the beginning of the next becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 后一者因连接另一有等而称为结生。

rows.pali: Tadetaṃ nāpi purimabhavā idhāgataṃ, nāpi tato kammasaṅkhāranativisayādihetuṃ vinā pātubhūtanti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: But it should be understood that it has neither come here from the previous becoming nor has it become manifest without the kamma, the formations, the pushing, the objective field, etc., as cause.
rows.chinese_translation: 应知它既不是从前一有来到此处，也不是没有业、行、所缘等来自过去有的原因而出现。
这里可以用回声等作譬喻：

rows.pali: Siyuṃ nidassanānettha, paṭighosādikā atha;
rows.english: 165. An echo, or its like, supplies The figures here; connectedness
rows.chinese_translation: 由于相续连接，既不是完全相同，也不是完全不同。

rows.pali: Santānabandhato natthi, ekatā nāpi nānatā.
rows.english: By continuity denies Identity and otherness.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里所举的识并未从过去有来到此处；它们是由属于过去有的原因生起的，因此可用回声、灯火、印章和映像等作譬喻。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Ettha cetassa viññāṇassa purimabhavato idha anāgamane, atītabhavapariyāpannahetūti ca uppāde paṭighosa-padīpa-muddā-paṭibimbappakārā dhammā nidassanāni siyuṃ.
rows.english: 166. And here let the illustration of this consciousness be such things as an echo, a light, a seal impression, a looking-glass image, for the fact of its not coming here from the previous becoming and for the fact that it arises owing to causes that are included in past becomings.
rows.chinese_translation: 正如回声、灯火、印章的影像等依声音等原因而生，却不是从别处迁移而来；这个心也是如此。

rows.pali: Yathā hi paṭighosa-padīpa-muddā-chāyā saddādihetukā honti aññatra agantvā evamevaṃ idaṃ cittaṃ.
rows.english: For just as an echo, a light, a seal impression, and a shadow have respectively sound, etc., as their cause and come into being without going elsewhere, so also this consciousness.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里因为有相续连接，所以既不是完全相同，也不是完全不同。

rows.pali: Ettha ca santānabandhato natthi ekatā nāpi nānatā.
rows.english: 167.And with a stream of continuity there is neither identity nor otherness.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果相续连接意味着绝对相同，那么乳就不会产生凝乳。

rows.pali: Yadi hi santānabandhe sati ekantamekatā bhaveyya, na khīrato dadhi sambhūtaṃ siyā.
rows.english: For if there were absolute identity in a stream of continuity, there would be no forming of curd from milk.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果又是绝对不同，那么凝乳就不会依赖乳。

rows.pali: Athāpi ekantanānatā bhaveyya, na khīrassādhīno dadhi siyā.
rows.english: And yet if there were absolute otherness, the curd would not be derived from the milk.
rows.chinese_translation: 一切由原因和缘所生的法，都应依此类推。

rows.pali: Esa nayo sabbahetuhetusamuppannesu.
rows.english: And so too with all causally arisen things.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果不是这样，世间一切言语和常规都将被取消；而这种结果并不可取。

rows.pali: Evañca sati sabbalokavohāralopo siyā, so ca aniṭṭho.
rows.english: And if that were so there would be an end to all worldly usage, which is hardly desirable.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果不是这样，世间一切言语和常规都将被取消；而这种结果不可取。

rows.pali: Tasmā ettha na ekantamekatā vā nānatā vā upagantabbāti.
rows.english: So neither absolute identity nor absolute otherness should be assumed here.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，这里不应执著于绝对相同或绝对不同。

rows.pali: 634.Etthāha – nanu evaṃ asaṅkantipātubhāve sati ye imasmiṃ manussattabhāve khandhā, tesaṃ niruddhattā, phalapaccayassa ca kammassa tattha agamanato aññassa aññato ca taṃ phalaṃ siyā, upabhuñjake ca asati kassa taṃ phalaṃ siyā, tasmā na sundaramidaṃ vidhānanti.
rows.english: 168. Here it might be asked: “If no transmigration is manifested, then after the cessation of the aggregates in this human person, that fruit could be another person’s or due to other [kamma], since the kamma that is the condition for the fruit does not pass on there [to where the fruit is]? And whose is the fruit since there is no experiencer? Therefore this formulation seems to be unsatisfactory. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：既然没有迁移和无因出现，那么今生的蕴已经灭去，作为果的原因的业也没有来到那里，怎么会有另一个从另一个产生？

rows.pali: Tatridaṃ vuccati –
rows.english: 169. Here is the reply:
rows.chinese_translation: 对此回答如下：

rows.pali: Santāne yaṃ phalaṃ etaṃ, nāññassa na ca aññato;
rows.english: In continuity the fruit Is neither of nor from another;
rows.chinese_translation: 相续中的果，既不是另一个的，也不是无因而来；

rows.pali: Bījānaṃ abhisaṅkhāro, etassatthassa sādhako.
rows.english: Seed’s forming processes will suit To show the purport of this matter.
rows.chinese_translation: 种子的造作，正能证明这一意义。

rows.pali: Ekasantānasmiṃ hi phalaṃ uppajjamānaṃ tattha ekantaekattanānattānaṃ paṭisiddhattā aññassāti vā aññatoti vā na hoti.
rows.english: 170. When a fruit arises in a single continuity, it is neither another’s nor from other [kamma] because absolute identity and absolute otherness are excluded32 there.
rows.note: 32. Paṭisiddhattā—“because … excluded”: paṭisiddha is not in PED. Abhisaṅkhāra here might mean “planting work,” not “formative processes.”
rows.chinese_translation: 在同一相续中生起的果，既已排除绝对的同一和绝对的差异，所以不能说它属于另一个，也不能说它来自另一个。

rows.pali: Etassa ca panatthassa bījānaṃ abhisaṅkhāro sādhako.
rows.english: The formative processes of seeds establish the meaning of this.
rows.chinese_translation: 种子的造作正能证明这一点。

rows.pali: Ambabījādīnaṃ hi abhisaṅkhāresu katesu tassa bījassa santāne laddhapaccayo kālantare phalaviseso uppajjamāno na aññabījānaṃ, nāpi aññābhisaṅkhārapaccayā uppajjati, na ca tāni bījāni, te abhisaṅkhārā vā phalaṭṭhānaṃ pāpuṇanti, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: For once the formative processes of a mango seed, etc., have been set afoot, when the particular fruit arises in the continuity of the seed’s [growth], later on owing to the obtaining of conditions, it does so neither as the fruit of other seeds nor from other formative processes as condition; and those seeds or formative processes do not themselves pass on to the place where the fruit is. This is the analogy here.
rows.chinese_translation: 例如芒果种子等经过造作后，经过一段时间，具足条件的种子相续中生起特殊的果；它不是由另一种子产生，也不是由另一种造作的条件产生，更不是无因而生。

rows.pali: Vijjāsipposadhādīhi cāpi bālasarīre upayuttehi kālantare vuḍḍhasarīrādīsu phaladehi ayamattho veditabbo.
rows.english: And the meaning can also be understood from the fact that the arts, crafts, medicine, etc., learnt in youth give their fruit later on in maturity.
rows.chinese_translation: 用知识、技艺、药物等施用于幼小身体，后来在长大的身体等处显现结果，也应依此理解。

rows.pali: Yampi vuttaṃ "upabhuñjake ca asati kassa taṃ phalaṃ siyā"ti, tattha,
rows.english: 171. Now, it was also asked, “Whose is the fruit, since there is no experiencer? ” Herein:
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：“如果没有享受者，这个果究竟属于谁？”对此说：

rows.pali: Phalassuppattiyā eva, siddhā bhuñjakasammuti;
rows.english: “Experiencer” is a convention For mere arising of the fruit;
rows.chinese_translation: 由于果生起，约定的享受者就成立；

rows.pali: Phaluppādena rukkhassa, yathā phalati sammuti.
rows.english: They say “It fruits” as a convention, When on a tree appears its fruit.
rows.chinese_translation: 正如树因果实生起而约定为结果实。

rows.pali: Yathā hi rukkhasaṅkhātānaṃ dhammānaṃ ekadesabhūtassa rukkhaphalassa uppattiyā eva rukkho phalatīti vā phalitoti vā vuccati, tathā devamanussasaṅkhātānaṃ khandhānaṃ ekadesabhūtassa upabhogasaṅkhātassa sukhadukkhaphalassa uppādeneva devo, manusso vā upabhuñjatīti vā, sukhito, dukkhitoti vā vuccati.
rows.english: 172. Just as it is simply owing to the arising of tree fruits, which are one part of the phenomena called a tree, that it is said “The tree fruits” or “The tree has fruited,” so it is simply owing to the arising of the fruit consisting of the pleasure and pain called experience, which is one part of the aggregates called “deities” and “human beings,” that it is said “A deity or a human being experiences or feels pleasure or pain.”
rows.chinese_translation: 正如树的诸法中某一部分称为树果，正因它生起才说树结果或已经结果；同样，天人和人所说诸蕴中的某一部分生起果，才约定说有情享受果。

rows.pali: Tasmā na ettha aññena upabhuñjakena nāma koci attho atthīti.
rows.english: There is therefore no need at all here for a superfluous experiencer.
rows.chinese_translation: 所以这里并不存在另一个所谓享受者。

rows.pali: 635.Yopi vadeyya "evaṃ santepi ete saṅkhārā vijjamānā vā phalassa paccayā siyuṃ, avijjamānā vā, yadi ca vijjamānā pavattikkhaṇeyeva nesaṃ vipākena bhavitabbaṃ, atha avijjamānā pavattito pubbe pacchā ca niccaṃ phalāvahā siyu"nti, so evaṃ vattabbo –
rows.english: 173. But it may be said: “That may be so; but then these formations must be the conditions for the fruit either when they are present or when they are not present, and if it is when they are present, their result must come about only at the moment of their occurrence; but if it is when they are not present, they must bear fruit constantly both before and after their occurrence. ” It can be replied:
rows.chinese_translation: 有人还说：既然如此，这些行在存在时或不存在时都可以成为果的缘；如果它们存在，就应在现行刹那立即有异熟，如果不存在，又不应成为缘。

rows.pali: Katattā paccayā ete, na ca niccaṃ phalāvahā;
rows.english: They are conditions when performed; They bear fruit once, but not again;
rows.chinese_translation: 对此应知，行是因已造作而成为缘，并非因为现存或不存在；它们也不恒常带来果。

rows.pali: Pāṭibhogādikaṃ tattha, veditabbaṃ nidassanaṃ.
rows.english: The agent and such similes Will serve to make the meaning plain.
rows.chinese_translation: 保证、担保等譬喻，应在这里如此理解。

rows.pali: Katattāyeva hi saṅkhārā attano phalassa paccayā honti, na vijjamānattā, avijjamānattā vā.
rows.english: 174. Formations are conditions for their own fruit because they have been performed, not because of presence or non-presence,
rows.chinese_translation: 行正因为已经造作，才成为自己果的缘，并不是因为它们现存或不存在。

rows.pali: Yathāha – "kāmāvacarassa kusalassa kammassa katattā upacitattā vipākaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hotī"tiādi (dha. sa. 431).
rows.english: according as it is said: [556] “Due to profitable kamma of the sense sphere having been performed, stored up [in the past], resultant eye-consciousness arises [in the present]” (Dhs §431), and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说：由于欲界善业已经造作并积集，异熟眼识等生起。

rows.pali: Yathārahassa ca attano phalassa paccayā hutvā na puna phalāvahā honti vipākattā.
rows.english: Having become conditions for their own fruit according to their capacity, they do not again bear fruit since the result has already ripened.
rows.chinese_translation: 行在适当时候成为自己果的缘，因为它是异熟；但在果成熟后，不会继续带来新的果。

rows.pali: Etassa catthassa vibhāvane idaṃ pāṭibhogādikaṃ nidassanaṃ veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: And in explaining the meaning of this the analogy of the agent, etc., should be understood.
rows.chinese_translation: 为了说明这一意义，应理解保证等譬喻。

rows.pali: Yathā hi loke yo kassaci atthassa niyyātanatthaṃ pāṭibhogo hoti, bhaṇḍaṃ vā kiṇāti, iṇaṃ vā gaṇhāti, tassa taṃ kiriyākaraṇamattameva tadatthaniyyātanādimhi paccayo hoti, na kiriyāya vijjamānattaṃ, avijjamānattaṃ vā, na ca tadatthaniyyātanādito parampi dhārakova hoti.
rows.english: For just as in the world when someone becomes an agent with the aim of completing some business or other, and he buys goods, say, or obtains a loan, it is simply the fact of his performing the transaction that is the condition for completing that business, not the transaction’s actual presence or non- presence; and after the completion of the business he has no further liability.
rows.chinese_translation: 世间有人为交付某物而作保证，或购买物品，或借取债务；他的这些行为本身，只在交付等目的上成为缘。

rows.pali: Kasmā?
rows.english: Why not?
rows.chinese_translation: 为什么？

rows.pali: Niyyātanādīnaṃ katattā.
rows.english: Because the business has been completed.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为交付等行为已经完成。

rows.pali: Evaṃ katattāva saṅkhārāpi attano phalassa paccayā honti, na ca yathārahaṃ phaladānato parampi phalāvahā hontīti.
rows.english: So it is because they have been performed that formations are conditions for their own fruit, and they do not bear fruit after they have already given fruit according to their capacity.
rows.chinese_translation: 同样，行正因为已经造作而成为自己果的缘；在适当给果之后，也不会继续产生果。

rows.pali: Ettāvatā missāmissavasena dvedhāpi vattamānassa paṭisandhiviññāṇassa saṅkhārapaccayā pavatti dīpitā hoti.
rows.english: Up to this point the occurrence, with formations as condition, of rebirth- linking consciousness that occurs in the two ways as mixed and unmixed [with materiality] has been illustrated.
rows.chinese_translation: 到这里，已经说明结生识依行缘而运作，且按混杂、不混杂分为两类。

rows.pali: 636.Idāni sabbesveva tesu bāttiṃsavipākaviññāṇesu sammohavighātatthaṃ,
rows.english: 175. Now, in order to eliminate confusion about all these thirty-two kinds of resultant consciousness:
rows.chinese_translation: 现在为消除对三十二种异熟识的迷惑，应依结生和现行说明：

rows.pali: Paṭisandhipavattīnaṃ, vasenete bhavādisu;
rows.english: One should of these formations see For which and how they are conditions
rows.chinese_translation: 在诸有等处，行是什么、以什么为缘，应当这样认识。

rows.pali: Vijānitabbā saṅkhārā, yathā yesañca paccayā.
rows.english: In birth and life in all the three Kinds of becoming and the rest.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中，三有、四生、五趣、七识住和九有情居，称为有等。

rows.pali: Tattha tayo bhavā, catasso yoniyo, pañca gatiyo, satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo, nava sattāvāsāti ete bhavādayo nāma.
rows.english: 176. Herein, the three kinds of becoming, the four kinds of generation, the five kinds of destiny, the seven stations of consciousness, and the nine abodes of beings are what are called “The kinds of becoming and the rest.”
rows.chinese_translation: 在这些有等中，于结生和现行时，行是哪些异熟识的缘、以何种方式成为缘，应当如实理解。

rows.pali: Etesu bhavādīsu paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca ete yesaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ paccayā, yathā ca paccayā honti, tathā vijānitabbāti attho.
rows.english: The meaning is that it should be recognized for what kinds of resultant consciousness these [formations] are conditions in rebirth-linking and in the course of an individual existence, and in what way they are conditions in the various kinds of becoming and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 先说福行：八种欲界意志所成的福行，在欲有善趣中，以不同刹那业缘和亲依止缘，普遍成为九种异熟识结生的缘。

rows.pali: Tattha puññābhisaṅkhāre tāva kāmāvacaraaṭṭhacetanābhedo puññābhisaṅkhāro avisesena kāmabhave sugatiyaṃ navannaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ nānakkhaṇikakammapaccayena ceva upanissayapaccayena cāti dvedhā paccayo.
rows.english: 177. Herein, firstly as regard the formation of merit: the formation of merit comprising the eight volitions of the sense sphere ((1)–(8)) is a condition in two ways, as kamma condition acting from a different time and as decisive-support condition, equally for all the nine kinds of resultant consciousness ((41)–(49)) in rebirth-linking in a happy destiny in the sense-sphere becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 五种色界善意志所成的福行，在色有结生时成为五种异熟识的缘。

rows.pali: Rūpāvacarapañcakusalacetanābhedo puññābhisaṅkhāro rūpabhave paṭisandhiyaṃ eva pañcannaṃ.
rows.english: That formation comprising the five profitable volitions of the fine-material sphere ((9)–(13)) [is a condition] in like manner for the five kinds of rebirth-linking in the fine-material becoming ((57)–(61)).
rows.chinese_translation: 前述欲界福行，在欲有善趣现行时，以同样两种方式成为七种广大异熟识以外的七种欲界有限异熟识的缘，但不成为结生缘。

rows.pali: Vuttappabhedakāmāvacaro pana kāmabhave sugatiyaṃ upekkhāsahagatāhetumanoviññāṇadhātuvajjānaṃ sattannaṃ parittavipākaviññāṇānaṃ vuttanayeneva dvedhā paccayo pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: 178. That of the sense sphere divided up as aforesaid is a condition in two ways, as aforesaid, for seven kinds of limited [-sphere] resultant consciousness ((34)–(40))—excluding the root-causeless mind-consciousness element accompanied by equanimity (41)—in the course of an existence, but not in rebirth- linking, in the happy destinies in the sense-sphere becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 同样的福行在色有现行时，成为五种异熟识的缘，但不成为结生缘。

rows.pali: Sveva rūpabhave pañcannaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: And that same formation is a condition likewise for five kinds of resultant consciousness ((34), (35), (39)–(41)) in the course of an existence, not in rebirth-linking, in the fine- material becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 在欲有恶趣中，它同样成为八种有限异熟识现行的缘，但不成为结生缘。

rows.pali: Kāmabhave pana duggatiyaṃ aṭṭhannampi parittavipākaviññāṇānaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: It is a condition likewise for eight kinds of limited [-sphere] resultant consciousness ((34)–(41)) in the course of existence, not in rebirth- linking, in the unhappy destinies in the sense-sphere becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 在地狱中，尊者大目犍连巡行地狱等处遇到可喜所缘时，福行成为其缘；在畜生和有大神通的饿鬼中，也能获得可喜所缘。

rows.pali: Tattha niraye mahāmoggallānattherassa narakacārikādīsu iṭṭhārammaṇasamāyoge so paccayo hoti, tiracchānesu pana petamahiddhikesu ca iṭṭhārammaṇaṃ labbhatiyeva.
rows.english: For then it is a condition [for such profitable-resultant consciousness occurring] in hell encountering a desirable object [on such occasions] as the Elder Mahā Moggallāna’s visits to hell, and so on. But among animals and powerful ghosts too a desirable object is obtained [through the same condition].
rows.chinese_translation: 同一福行在欲有善趣中，成为十六种善异熟识现行和结生的缘。

rows.pali: Sveva kāmabhave sugatiyaṃ soḷasannampi kusalavipākaviññāṇānaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte ca paṭisandhiyañca.
rows.english: 179. This eightfold formation of merit is also a condition likewise for sixteen kinds of profitable-resultant consciousness in the course of an existence ((34)– (41)) and in rebirth-linking ((42)–(49)) in the happy destinies in the sense- sphere becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 普遍说，福行在色有中以同样方式成为十种异熟识现行和结生的缘。

rows.pali: Avisesena pana puññābhisaṅkhāro rūpabhave dasannaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte ca paṭisandhiyañca.
rows.english: It is also a condition equally for all ten kinds of resultant consciousness in the course of an existence ((34), (35), (39)–(41)) and in rebirth- linking ((57)–(61)) in the fine-material becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 总的说，福行在色有中以同样方式成为十种异熟识现行和结生的缘。

rows.pali: Dvādasākusalacetanābhedo apuññābhisaṅkhāro kāmabhave duggatiyaṃ ekassa viññāṇassa tatheva paccayo paṭisandhiyaṃ, no pavatte.
rows.english: 180. The formation of demerit, comprising the twelve unprofitable volitions ((22)–(33)), is a condition likewise in the unhappy destinies in the sense-sphere becoming for one kind of consciousness in rebirth-linking (56), not in the course of an existence;
rows.chinese_translation: 十二种不善意志所成的非福行，在欲有恶趣中以同样方式成为一种识结生的缘，但不成为现行缘。

rows.pali: Channaṃ pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: also for six kinds in the course of an existence ((50)–(55)), not in rebirth-linking;
rows.chinese_translation: 在现行中成为六种识的缘，但不成为结生缘。

rows.pali: Sattannampi akusalavipākaviññāṇānaṃ pavatte ca paṭisandhiyañca.
rows.english: and for all the seven kinds partly in the course of an existence and partly in rebirth-linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 成为七种不善异熟识现行和结生的缘。

rows.pali: Kāmabhave pana sugatiyaṃ tesaṃyeva sattannaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: And in the happy destinies in the sense-sphere becoming it is a condition likewise for those same seven kinds in the course of an existence, not in rebirth-linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 在欲有善趣中，对这七种识同样成为现行缘，但不成为结生缘。

rows.pali: Rūpabhave catunnaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: In the fine-material becoming it is a condition likewise for four kinds of resultant consciousness ((50)–(51), (55), (56)) in the course of an existence, not in rebirth-linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 在色有中，对四种异熟识同样成为现行缘，但不成为结生缘。

rows.pali: So ca kho kāmāvacare aniṭṭharūpadassanasaddasavanavasena, brahmaloke pana aniṭṭharūpādayo nāma natthi.
rows.english: Then it is a condition for [Brahmās’] seeing undesirable visible data and hearing undesirable sounds that are in the sense sphere: there are no undesirable visible data, etc., in the Brahmā-world itself;
rows.chinese_translation: 在欲界，这是由于看见不喜色、听到不喜声等；但梵天界不存在所谓不喜色等。

rows.pali: Tathā kāmāvacaradevalokepi.
rows.english: and likewise in the divine world of the sense sphere.33
rows.note: 33. Vism-mhṭ points out that this is generally but not always so, since deities see such portents of their death as the fading of their flow...
rows.chinese_translation: 欲界诸天中也同样不存在这些不喜所缘。

rows.pali: Āneñjābhisaṅkhāro arūpabhave catunnaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ tatheva paccayo pavatte ca paṭisandhiyañca.
rows.english: 181.The formation of the imperturbable is a condition likewise for four kinds of resultant consciousness ((62)–(65)) in the course of an existence and in rebirth- linking in the immaterial becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 不动行在无色有中，以同样方式成为四种异熟识现行和结生的缘。

rows.pali: Evaṃ tāva bhavesu paṭisandhipavattīnaṃ vasena ete saṅkhārā yesaṃ paccayā, yathā ca paccayā honti, tathā vijānitabbā.
rows.english: This, firstly, is how it should be understood what kinds of resultant consciousness these formations are conditions for in rebirth-linking and in the [three] kinds of becoming, and in what way they are conditions.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，先应依诸有中结生和现行，认识这些行是哪些法的缘、以什么方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Eteneva nayena yoniādīsupi veditabbā.
rows.english: And it should also be understood in the same way of the kinds of generation and so on.
rows.chinese_translation: 依此方法，生处等也应理解。

rows.pali: 637.Tatridaṃ ādito paṭṭhāya mukhamattapakāsanaṃ – imesu hi saṅkhāresu yasmā puññābhisaṅkhāro tāva dvīsu bhavesu paṭisandhiṃ datvā sabbamattano vipākaṃ janeti.
rows.english: 182. Here is a statement of the bare headings starting from the beginning. Of these [three kinds of] formations, firstly the formation of merit, when giving rebirth-linking, produces the whole of its result in two of the kinds of becoming;
rows.chinese_translation: 这里从开头只作一个概要说明：在这些行中，福行在两种有中给予结生后，产生自身全部异熟。

rows.pali: Tathā aṇḍajādīsu catūsu yonīsu, devamanussasaṅkhātāsu dvīsu gatīsu, nānattakāyanānattasaññīnānattakāyaekattasaññī-ekattakāyanānattasaññī-ekattakāyaekattasaññīsaṅkhātāsu catūsu viññāṇaṭṭhitīsu.
rows.english: likewise in the four kinds of generation beginning with the egg-born, in two of the kinds of destiny, in other words, the divine and the human; in four of the stations of consciousness, [the human, and the planes of the first, second and third jhānas,] described thus, “Different in body and different in perception … different in body and same in perception … same in body and different in perception … same in body and same in perception …;” (D III 253)
rows.chinese_translation: 同样，在四种生处、天人与人这两趣，以及各种身各种想、各种身一想、一身各种想和一身一想等识住中也是如此。

rows.pali: Asaññasattāvāse panesa rūpamattamevābhisaṅkharotīti catūsuyeva sattāvāsesu ca paṭisandhiṃ datvā sabbamattano vipākaṃ janeti.
rows.english: and in only four of the abodes of beings, because in the abode of non-percipient beings it only forms materiality.
rows.chinese_translation: 在无想有情居中，它只造作色法，所以在四种有情居中给予结生后，产生自身全部异熟。

rows.pali: Tasmā esa etesu dvīsu bhavesu, catūsu yonīsu, dvīsu gatīsu, catūsu viññāṇaṭṭhitīsu, catūsu sattāvāsesu ca ekavīsatiyā vipākaviññāṇānaṃ vuttanayeneva paccayo hoti yathāsambhavaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca.
rows.english: Therefore it is a condition in the way already stated for twenty-one kinds of resultant consciousness in these two kinds of becoming, four kinds of generation, two kinds of destiny, four stations of consciousness, and four abodes of beings according as they are produced in rebirth-linking ((41)–(49), (57)–(61)) [558] and the course of an existence ((34)–(41)), as appropriate.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，它在这两种有、四种生处、两趣、四种识住和四种有情居中，依前述方法成为二十一种异熟识的缘。

rows.pali: Apuññābhisaṅkhāro pana yasmā ekasmiṃyeva kāmabhave catūsu yonīsu, avasesāsu tīsu gatīsu, nānattakāyaekattasaññīsaṅkhātāya ekissā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā, tādiseyeva ca ekasmiṃ sattāvāse paṭisandhivasena vipaccati, tasmā esa ekasmiṃ bhave, catūsu yonīsu, tīsu gatīsu, ekissā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā, ekamhi ca sattāvāse sattannaṃ vipākaviññāṇānaṃ vuttanayeneva paccayo paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca.
rows.english: 183. The formation of demerit as rebirth-linking ripens in the sense- sphere becoming only, in the four kinds of generation, in the remaining three destinies, in the one station of consciousness described thus “different in body and same in perception” (D III 253), and in the one corresponding abode of beings. Therefore it is a condition in the way already stated for seven kinds of resultant consciousness in one kind of becoming, in four kinds of generation, in three kinds of destiny, in one station of consciousness, and in one abode of beings, both in rebirth-linking (56) and in the course of an existence ((50)–(56)).
rows.chinese_translation: 非福行只在一个欲有、四种生处、其余三趣、一个名为各种身一想的识住，以及一个相应的有情居中成为缘。

rows.pali: Āneñjābhisaṅkhāro pana yasmā ekasmiṃyeva arūpabhave, ekissā opapātikayoniyā, ekissā devagatiyā, ākāsānañcāyatanādikāsu tīsu viññāṇaṭṭhitīsu, ākāsānañcāyatanādikesu ca catūsu sattāvāsesu paṭisandhivasena vipaccati, tasmā esa ekasmiṃ bhave, ekissā yoniyā, ekissā gatiyā, tīsu viññāṇaṭṭhitīsu, catūsu sattāvāsesu catunnaṃ viññāṇānaṃ vuttanayeneva paccayo hoti paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte cāti.
rows.english: 184.The formation of the imperturbable as rebirth-linking ripens in the immaterial becoming, in the apparitional kind of generation only, in the divine destiny only, in the three stations of consciousness beginning with the base consisting of boundless space, and in the four abodes of beings beginning with the base consisting of boundless space ((62)– (65)). Therefore it is a condition in the way already stated for the four kinds of consciousness in one kind of becoming, in one kind of generation, in one kind of destiny, in three stations of consciousness, and in four abodes of beings, both in rebirth-linking and in the course of becoming. 34
rows.note: 34. A Sinhalese text adds the following paragraph: “Also the bodily formation, when giving rebirth-linking, gives the whole of its results i...
rows.chinese_translation: 不动行只在一个无色有、一个化生处、一个天趣、空无边处等三个识住，以及空无边处等四个有情居中成为缘。

rows.pali: Evaṃ,
rows.english: 185. This is how:
rows.chinese_translation: 因此：

rows.pali: Paṭisandhipavattīnaṃ, vasenete bhavādisu;
rows.english: One should of these formations see For which and how they are conditions
rows.chinese_translation: 应依结生和现行，

rows.pali: Vijānitabbā saṅkhārā, yathā yesañca paccayāti.
rows.english: In birth and life and the three Kinds of becoming and the rest.
rows.chinese_translation: 认识诸有等处的行，

rows.pali: Ayaṃ "saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇa"nti padasmiṃ vitthārakathā.
rows.english: This is the detailed explanation of the clause, “With formations as condition, consciousness. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 以及它们是哪些法的缘、以何种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: 638.Viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpapade –
rows.english: 186. For the clause, “With consciousness as condition, mentality-materiality”:
rows.chinese_translation: 在“以识为缘而有名色”一项中：

rows.pali: Vibhāgā nāmarūpānaṃ, bhavādīsu pavattito;
rows.english: (1) By analysis of mind and matter, (2) Occurrence in becoming, etc.,
rows.chinese_translation: 应从名色的分类、在有等处的运作，以及缘的摄持方式，理解这里的分析。

rows.pali: Saṅgahā paccayanayā, viññātabbo vinicchayo.
rows.english: (3) Inclusion, and (4) manner of condition, The exposition should be known.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里名是面向所缘而趋向的受等三蕴，色是四大种和四大所造的色法。

rows.pali: Vibhāgā nāmarūpānanti ettha hi nāmanti ārammaṇābhimukhaṃ namanato vedanādayo tayo khandhā, rūpanti cattāri mahābhūtāni catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāyarūpaṃ.
rows.english: 187. 1. By analysis of mind and matter: here “mind” (nāma—mentality) is the three aggregates, that is, feeling, perception, and formations, because of their bending (namana) on to the object. “Matter” (rūpa—materiality) is the four great primary elements and the materiality derived [by clinging] from the four great primaries.
rows.chinese_translation: 它们的分类已经在蕴的说明中说过。

rows.pali: Tesaṃ vibhāgo khandhaniddese vuttoyevāti.
rows.english: Their analysis is given in the Description of the Aggregates (XIV.34f., 125f.).
rows.chinese_translation: 所以这里先应依名色的分类理解分析。

rows.pali: Evaṃ tāvettha vibhāgā nāmarūpānaṃ viññātabbo vinicchayo.
rows.english: This, in the first place, is how the exposition of mentality-materiality should be known “by analysis. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 这里应这样理解名色分类方面的分析。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Bhavādīsu pavattitoti ettha ca nāmaṃ ekaṃ sattāvāsaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbabhavayonigativiññāṇaṭṭhitisesasattāvāsesu pavattati, rūpaṃ dvīsu bhavesu, catūsu yonīsu, pañcasu gatīsu, purimāsu catūsu viññāṇaṭṭhitīsu, pañcasu sattāvāsesu pavattati.
rows.english: 188. 2. By occurrence in becoming, et cetera: excepting one abode of beings, [that is, the non-percipient,] mentality occurs in all the kinds of becoming, generation, destiny, and station of consciousness, and in the remaining abodes of beings. Materiality occurs in two kinds of becoming, four kinds of generation, five destinies, the first four stations of consciousness, and the first five abodes of beings.
rows.chinese_translation: 所谓在有等处运作，是说名除去一个有情居外，在其余一切有、生处、趣、识住和有情居中运作；色则在两种有、四种生处、五趣、前四种识住和五种有情居中运作。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Evaṃ pavattamāne ca etasmiṃ nāmarūpe yasmā abhāvakagabbhaseyyakānaṃ aṇḍajānañca paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthukāyadasakavasena rūpato dvesantatisīsāni, tayo ca arūpino khandhā pātubhavanti, tasmā tesaṃ vitthārena rūparūpato vīsati dhammā, tayo ca arūpino khandhāti ete tevīsati dhammā viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti veditabbā.
rows.english: 189.Now, when this mentality-materiality occurs thus, [559] then in the case of sexless embryos and the egg-born, at the moment of their rebirth-linking there are manifested as materiality two organic continuities, that is, the two decads of physical basis and body, and also the three immaterial aggregates. So in their case there are in detail these twenty-three states, namely, twenty states as concrete matter and three immaterial aggregates, which should be understood as “mentality-materiality with consciousness as condition.”
rows.chinese_translation: 若按未取者不再计入的方式，从一个相续首除去九种色法，就成为十四种法。

rows.pali: Aggahitaggahaṇena pana ekasantatisīsato nava rūpadhamme apanetvā cuddasa.
rows.english: But omitting repetitions,35 and so cancelling nine material instances (see 11.88) from one of the organic continuities, fourteen states remain.
rows.note: 35. Resolve compound agahitagahaṇena as gahitassa a-gahaṇena, not as a-gahitassa gahaṇena; i.e. it is “by not taking what is taken,” not “by...
rows.chinese_translation: 对于有性者，加上性根十法聚，成为三十三；同样从两个相续首除去十八种未取法，成为十五种。

rows.pali: Sabhāvakānaṃ bhāvadasakaṃ pakkhipitvā tettiṃsa, tesampi aggahitaggahaṇena santatisīsadvayato aṭṭhārasa rūpadhamme apanetvā pannarasa.
rows.english: By adding the sex decad for those possessed of sex [before making the above cancellation] there are thirty-three. And omitting repetitions and so cancelling eighteen material instances [nine each] from two of the organic continuities, in this case fifteen states remain.
rows.chinese_translation: 对于有性者，加上性根十法聚，成为三十三；同样从两个相续首除去十八种未取法，成为十五种。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Yasmā ca opapātikasattesu brahmakāyikādīnaṃ paṭisandhikkhaṇe cakkhusotavatthudasakānaṃ, jīvitindriyanavakassa ca vasena rūpato cattāri santatisīsāni, tayo ca arūpino khandhā pātubhavanti, tasmā tesaṃ vitthārena rūparūpato ekūnacattālīsa dhammā, tayo ca arūpino khandhāti ete bācattālīsa dhammā viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti veditabbā.
rows.english: 190. At the moment of rebirth-linking of those of Brahmā’s Retinue, among apparitionally born beings, four organic continuities are manifested as materiality, that is, the decads of eye, ear, and physical basis, and the ennead of the life faculty, and three immaterial aggregates. So in their case in detail these forty-two states, namely, thirty-nine states as concrete materiality and three immaterial aggregates, should be understood as “mentality-materiality with consciousness as condition.”
rows.chinese_translation: 若按未取者不再计入，从三个相续首除去二十七种法，成为十五种。

rows.pali: Aggahitaggahaṇena pana santatisīsattayato sattavīsati dhamme apanetvā pannarasa.
rows.english: But omitting repetitions and so cancelling twenty- seven instances of materiality [nine each] from three of the organic continuities, fifteen states remain.
rows.chinese_translation: 欲有中，其余化生者、湿生者或具有完整性根和处的有情，在结生刹那有七个色相续首和三个无色蕴。

rows.pali: Kāmabhave pana yasmā sesaopapātikānaṃ, saṃsedajānaṃ vā sabhāvakaparipuṇṇāyatanānaṃ paṭisandhikkhaṇe rūpato satta santatisīsāni, tayo ca arūpino khandhā pātubhavanti, tasmā tesaṃ vitthārena rūparūpato sattati dhammā, tayo ca arūpino khandhāti ete tesattati dhammā viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti veditabbā.
rows.english: 191. In the sense-sphere becoming, seven organic continuities are manifested as materiality, and also three immaterial aggregates at the moment of rebirth- linking of the remaining kinds of apparitionally born or of the moisture-born possessing sex and matured sense bases. So in their case in detail these seventy- three states, namely, seventy instances of concrete materiality and three immaterial aggregates, should be understood as “mentality-materiality with formations as condition.”
rows.chinese_translation: 按未取者不再计入，从六个色相续首除去五十四种法，成为十九种。

rows.pali: Aggahitaggahaṇena pana rūpasantatisīsachakkato catupaññāsa dhamme apanetvā ekūnavīsati.
rows.english: But omitting repetitions and so cancelling fifty-four material instances [nine each] from six of the organic continuities, nineteen states remain.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是最大数。

rows.pali: Esa ukkaṃso.
rows.english: This is the maximum.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是最大数。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Avakaṃsena pana taṃtaṃrūpasantatisīsavikalānaṃ tassa tassa vasena hāpetvā hāpetvā saṅkhepato vitthārato ca paṭisandhiyaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpasaṅkhā veditabbā.
rows.english: But at minimum the computation of “mentality- materiality with consciousness as condition” in the rebirth-linking of those who lack such and such an organic continuity can be understood in brief and detail by reducing it appropriately. [The blind, for instance, lack the eye decad.]
rows.chinese_translation: 无色有情只有三个无色蕴。

rows.pali: Arūpīnaṃ pana tayova arūpino khandhā.
rows.english: 192. For mentality-materiality immaterial beings have only the three [mental] aggregates;
rows.chinese_translation: 无想有情在色法方面只有命根九法聚。

rows.pali: Asaññīnaṃ rūpato jīvitindriyanavakamevāti.
rows.english: while non-percipient beings have only the life-faculty ennead, and that represents materiality.
rows.chinese_translation: 以上是结生时的情况。

rows.pali: Esa tāva paṭisandhiyaṃ nayo.
rows.chinese_translation: 在现行中，一切有色法运作的处所，在结生心住立的刹那，与结生心同时，由时节生起的纯八法聚出现。

rows.pali: Pavatte pana sabbattha rūpappavattidese paṭisandhicittassa ṭhitikkhaṇe paṭisandhicittena saha pavattaututo utusamuṭṭhānaṃ suddhaṭṭhakaṃ pātubhavati.
rows.english: 193. In the course of an existence, in all places where materiality occurs there is manifested the temperature-originated bare [material] octad, which is due [initially] to the temperature that occurred together with the rebirth-linking consciousness at the moment of its presence.36
rows.chinese_translation: 在现行中，一切有色法运作的处所，在结生心住立的刹那，与结生心同时，由时节生起的纯八法聚出现。

rows.pali: Paṭisandhicittaṃ pana rūpaṃ na samuṭṭhāpeti.
rows.english: Rebirth-linking consciousness does not originate materiality.
rows.chinese_translation: 结生心本身不使色法生起。

rows.pali: Tañhi yathā papāte patitapuriso parassa paccayo hotuṃ na sakkoti, evaṃ vatthudubbalatāya dubbalattā rūpaṃ samuṭṭhāpetuṃ na sakkoti.
rows.english: For, just as a man who is falling into a chasm cannot support another, so it, too, is unable to originate materiality because of its weakness, which is due to the weakness of the physical basis.
rows.chinese_translation: 它因所依处微弱，力量不足，不能使色法生起，犹如从悬崖跌落的人无法成为他人的支撑。

rows.pali: Paṭisandhicittato pana uddhaṃ paṭhamabhavaṅgato pabhuti cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ suddhaṭṭhakaṃ, saddapātubhāvakāle paṭisandhikkhaṇato uddhaṃ pavattaututo ceva cittato ca saddanavakaṃ, ye pana kabaḷīkārāhārūpajīvino gabbhaseyyakasattā, tesaṃ,
rows.english: But from the first life-continuum after the rebirth-linking consciousness onwards, [560] the bare octad originated by consciousness appears. And at the time when sound becomes manifest there is the sound ennead due both to temperature occurring after the moment of rebirth-linking and to consciousness. 194. The bare octad originated by nutriment appears in beings in the womb who live on matter consisting of physical nutriment as soon as their body is suffused by nutriment swallowed by the mother; for it is said:
rows.chinese_translation: 从结生心之后、即从第一个有分心开始，出现由心生起的纯八法聚；声音出现时，从结生刹那以后，由时节和心共同生起九法聚。

rows.pali: "Yañcassa bhuñjati mātā, annaṃ pānañca bhojanaṃ;
rows.english: And so it is that when his mother Eats, consuming food and drink,
rows.chinese_translation: 经中说：

rows.pali: Tena so tattha yāpeti, mātukucchigato naro"ti. –
rows.english: One hidden in his mother’s womb Thereby obtains his nourishment (S I 206).
rows.chinese_translation: 母亲所吃的食物、饮料和饮食，

rows.pali: Vacanato mātarā ajjhoharitāhārena anugate sarīre, opapātikānaṃ sabbapaṭhamaṃ attano mukhagataṃ kheḷaṃ ajjhoharaṇakāle āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ suddhaṭṭhakanti idaṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānassa suddhaṭṭhakassa, utucittasamuṭṭhānānañca ukkaṃsato dvinnaṃ navakānaṃ vasena chabbīsatividhaṃ, pubbe ekekacittakkhaṇe tikkhattuṃ uppajjamānaṃ vuttaṃ kammasamuṭṭhānañca sattatividhanti channavutividhaṃ rūpaṃ, tayo ca arūpino khandhāti samāsato navanavuti dhammā.
rows.english: And it appears in apparitionally born beings as soon as they first swallow the spittle that has come into their own mouths. So, with the twenty-six [material instances] consisting of the bare octad originated by nutriment, and of the, at most, two [sound] enneads originated respectively by temperature and consciousness, and also with the already- mentioned seventy kamma-originated instances (§191) that arise three times in each conscious moment [at the instants of arising, presence, and dissolution], there are thus ninety-six material instances; and with the three immaterial aggregates there is thus a total of ninety-nine states.
rows.chinese_translation: 胎中的人便依靠它们维生。

rows.pali: Yasmā vā saddo aniyato kadācideva pātubhāvato, tasmā duvidhampi taṃ apanetvā ime sattanavuti dhammā yathāsambhavaṃ sabbasattānaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: 195. Or because sound is not regularly present since it is only sometimes manifested, subtracting it therefore as twofold [being temperature-originated and consciousness-originated], there are these ninety-seven states to be understood as “mentality-materiality with consciousness as condition” in all beings, according as it happens to be produced.
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，胎儿的身体由母亲摄取的食物滋养；化生有情第一次吞咽自己口中的唾液时，则生起食生纯八法聚。

rows.pali: Tesaṃ hi suttānampi pamattānampi khādantānampi pivantānampi divā ca rattiñca ete viññāṇapaccayā pavattanti.
rows.english: For whether these beings are sleeping or idling or eating or drinking, these states keep on occurring in them day and night with consciousness as condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 由于声音并不确定，只在有时出现，所以除去这两种偶发法后，应知这九十七种法依各自可能，都是一切有情以识为缘的名色。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Tañca nesaṃ viññāṇapaccayabhāvaṃ parato vaṇṇayissāma.
rows.english: And we shall explain later how they have consciousness as their condition (see §200ff.).
rows.chinese_translation: 无论有情睡眠、醒着、吃东西还是饮水，无论白天黑夜，这些法都以识为缘而运作。

rows.pali: Yampanetamettha kammajarūpaṃ, taṃ bhavayonigatiṭhitisattāvāsesu sabbapaṭhamaṃ patiṭṭhahantampi tisamuṭṭhānikarūpena anupatthaddhaṃ na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ, nāpi tisamuṭṭhānikaṃ tena anupatthaddhaṃ.
rows.english: 196. Now, although this kamma-born materiality is the first to find a footing in the several kinds of becoming, generation, destiny, station of consciousness, and abode of beings, it is nevertheless unable to carry on without being consolidated by materiality of triple origination [by consciousness, temperature, and nutriment], nor can that of triple origination do so without being consolidated by the former.
rows.chinese_translation: 这些法成为识缘的情形，我们将在后文说明。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Atha kho vātabbhāhatāpi catuddisā vavatthāpitā naḷakalāpiyo viya, ūmivegabbhāhatāpi mahāsamudde katthaci laddhapatiṭṭhā bhinnavāhanikā viya ca aññamaññupatthaddhānevetāni apatamānāni saṇṭhahitvā ekampi vassaṃ dvepi vassāni - pe - vassasatampi yāva tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyukkhayo vā puññakkhayo vā, tāva pavattantīti.
rows.english: But when they thus give consolidating support to each other, they can stand up without falling, like sheaves of reeds propped together on all four sides, even though battered by the wind, and like [boats with] broken floats37 that have found a support, even though battered by waves somewhere in mid-ocean, and they can last one year, two years … a hundred years, until those beings’ life span or their merit is exhausted.
rows.note: 37. Vāhanika—“having a float”: not in PED. The context suggests a catamaran, universal in Indian waters.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里的业生色，即使最先在有、 生处、趣、识住和有情居中建立，也不能仅凭三种生起的色法支持而独立站立，也不能没有它们而维持。

rows.pali: Evaṃ bhavādīsu pavattitopettha viññātabbo vinicchayo.
rows.english: This is how the exposition should be understood here “by occurrence in becoming, etc.”
rows.chinese_translation: 它们彼此支持，正如被风吹动、四方固定的芦苇束，又如大海中被波浪冲击、在某处获得支撑却彼此交错的木筏。

rows.pali: 639.Saṅgahāti ettha ca yaṃ āruppe pavattipaṭisandhīsu, pañcavokārabhave ca pavattiyaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmameva, yañca asaññesu sabbattha, pañcavokārabhave ca pavattiyaṃ viññāṇapaccayā rūpameva, yañca pañcavokārabhave sabbattha viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ nāmañca rūpañca nāmarūpañca nāmarūpanti evaṃ ekadesasarūpekasesanayena saṅgahetvā viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: 197. 3. By inclusion: now there is (a) the simple mentality with consciousness as condition in both the course of an existence and rebirth-linking in the immaterial sphere, and in the course of an existence in the five-constituent becoming, and (b) the simple materiality with consciousness as condition in both cases among the non-percipient, and in the course of an existence in the five-constituent becoming, and (c) the [combined] mentality-materiality [561] with consciousness as condition in both cases in the five-constituent becoming. All that mentality and materiality and mentality-materiality should be understood as “mentality-materiality with consciousness as condition,” including them under mentality-materiality according to the method that allows any one part to represent any remaining one of its kind. 38
rows.note: 38. The expression “ekadesasarūpekasesa” is grammatically explained at Vism-mhṭ 623; see allied expressions, “katekasesa” (§204) and “ekases...
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，这里也应从名色在有等处运作来理解分析。

rows.pali: Asaññesu viññāṇābhāvā ayuttanti ce, nāyuttaṃ.
rows.english: 198. Is this correct in view of the absence of consciousness in non-percipient beings? —It is not incorrect.
rows.chinese_translation: 关于摄持，这里在无色有的现行和结生、五蕴有的现行中，以识为缘的只是名；在无想有的一切时候，以及五蕴有的结生中，以识为缘的只是色。

rows.pali: Idampi,
rows.english: For:
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：无想有情没有识，这样说岂不是不合理？不，不是不合理。

rows.pali: Nāmarūpassa yaṃ hetu, viññāṇaṃ taṃ dvidhā mataṃ;
rows.english: This consciousness, as cause of mind And matter, is twice reckoned:
rows.chinese_translation: 这里还应这样理解：

rows.pali: Vipākamavipākañca, yuttameva yato idaṃ.
rows.english: Result, and also not-result. Wherefore this is correctly said.
rows.chinese_translation: 识是名色的原因，分为两种；

rows.pali: Yañhi nāmarūpassa hetu viññāṇaṃ, taṃ vipākāvipākabhedato dvedhā mataṃ.
rows.english: 199. The consciousness that is the cause of mentality-materiality is reckoned to be twofold classed as resultant and not resultant.
rows.chinese_translation: 异熟和非异熟，正因如此而合理。

rows.pali: Idañca asaññasattesu kammasamuṭṭhānattā pañcavokārabhave pavattaabhisaṅkhāraviññāṇapaccayā rūpaṃ.
rows.english: And since in the case of non-percipient beings materiality is originated by kamma, it has as its condition kamma-formation consciousness that occurred in the five-constituent becoming.
rows.chinese_translation: 作为名色原因的识，依异熟与非异熟分为两类。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Tathā pañcavokāre pavattiyaṃ kusalādicittakkhaṇe kammasamuṭṭhānanti yuttameva idaṃ.
rows.english: This applies also to the kamma-originated materiality arising in the course of an existence in the five-constituent becoming at the moment of profitable or any other consciousness. So this is correct.
rows.chinese_translation: 在无想有情中，色由业生起；在五蕴有的现行中，色由福行等所成的识作为缘而生起。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Evaṃ saṅgahatopettha viññātabbo vinicchayo.
rows.english: This is how the exposition can also be known here “by inclusion. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，这里的分析也应从摄持方式来理解。

rows.pali: 640.Paccayanayāti ettha hi,
rows.english: 200. 4. By manner of condition: here:
rows.chinese_translation: 关于缘的方式，这里说：

rows.pali: Nāmassa pākaviññāṇaṃ, navadhā hoti paccayo;
rows.english: Resultant-consciousness conditions Mentality first in nine ways,
rows.chinese_translation: 异熟识对名有九种缘，

rows.pali: Vatthurūpassa navadhā, sesarūpassa aṭṭhadhā.
rows.english: Then basis matter in nine ways, And other matter in eight ways;
rows.chinese_translation: 对所依色有九种，对其余色有八种。

rows.pali: Abhisaṅkhāraviññāṇaṃ, hoti rūpassa ekadhā;
rows.english: Formation-consciousness conditions This matter in a single way.
rows.chinese_translation: 福行所成的识，对色只有一种缘；

rows.pali: Tadaññaṃ pana viññāṇaṃ, tassa tassa yathārahaṃ.
rows.english: The rest of consciousness conditions This matter as the case may be.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余识则依各自情形成为相应法的缘。

rows.pali: Yañhetaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ pavattiyaṃ vā vipākasaṅkhātaṃ nāmaṃ, tassa rūpamissassa vā amissassa vā paṭisandhikaṃ vā aññaṃ vā vipākaviññāṇaṃ sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttavipākāhārindriyaatthiavigatapaccayehi navadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 201. Rebirth-linking or some other kind of resultant consciousness is a condition in nine ways, as conascence, mutuality, support, association, kamma- result, nutriment, faculty, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, either at rebirth-linking or in the course of an existence, for that mentality called resultant, whether mixed with materiality or not.
rows.chinese_translation: 无论结生还是现行，称为异熟的名，以异熟识为缘；该识无论与色混杂、不混杂，结生或其他时，都以俱生、相互、依止、相应、异熟、食、根、离去、有和不离去等方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Vatthurūpassa paṭisandhiyaṃ sahajātaaññamaññanissayavipākāhārindriyavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayehi navadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: At rebirth-linking it is a condition in nine ways, as conascence, mutuality, support, kamma-result, nutriment, faculty, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for the materiality of the physical [heart-] basis.
rows.chinese_translation: 在结生时，它对所依色以俱生、相互、依止、异熟、食、根、不相应、有和不离去九种缘成为缘。

rows.pali: Ṭhapetvā pana vatthurūpaṃ sesarūpassa imesu navasu aññamaññapaccayaṃ apanetvā sesehi aṭṭhahi paccayehi paccayo hoti.
rows.english: It is a condition in eight ways, namely, as the above conditions omitting the mutuality condition, for materiality other than the materiality of the physical basis.
rows.chinese_translation: 除所依色外，对其余色除去相互缘，以其余八种缘成为缘。

rows.pali: Abhisaṅkhāraviññāṇaṃ pana asaññasattarūpassa vā pañcavokārabhave vā kammajassa rūpassa suttantikapariyāyato upanissayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hoti.
rows.english: Kamma-formation consciousness is a condition in one way only, as decisive- support condition, for the materiality of non-percipient beings, or for the kamma- born materiality in the five-constituent becoming, according to the Suttanta method.
rows.chinese_translation: 福行所成的识，依经藏说法，对无想有情的色或五蕴有中的业生色，仅以亲依止一种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Avasesaṃ paṭhamabhavaṅgato pabhuti sabbampi viññāṇaṃ tassa tassa nāmarūpassa yathārahaṃ paccayo hotīti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: All the remaining kinds of consciousness from the time of the first life- continuum [consciousness following rebirth-linking] onwards should be understood as a condition for some kind of mentality-materiality as appropriate.
rows.chinese_translation: 其余从第一个有分心开始的一切识，都应依各自情形成为相应名色的缘。

rows.pali: Vitthārato pana tassa paccayanaye dassiyamāne sabbāpi paṭṭhānakathā vitthāretabbā hotīti na naṃ ārabhāma.
rows.english: But since the whole contents of the Paṭṭhāna must be cited in order to show how it acts in detail, we do not undertake that.
rows.chinese_translation: 如果详细说明它的缘，就必须展开全部《发趣论》的论述，所以这里不再展开。

rows.pali: Tattha siyā – kathaṃ panetaṃ jānitabbaṃ "paṭisandhināmarūpaṃ viññāṇapaccayā hotī"ti?
rows.english: 202. Here it may be asked: “But how is it to be known [562] that the mentality- materiality of rebirth-linking has consciousness as its condition?”
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：怎样知道“结生名色以识为缘”？

rows.pali: Suttato yuttito ca.
rows.english: From the suttas and from logic.
rows.chinese_translation: 依据经文和推理。

rows.pali: Sutte hi "cittānuparivattino dhammā"tiādinā (dha. sa. dukamātikā 62) nayena bahudhā vedanādīnaṃ viññāṇapaccayatā siddhā.
rows.english: For in the suttas it is established in many places that feeling, etc., have consciousness as condition in the way beginning, “States with parallel occurrence through consciousness” (Dhs §1522).
rows.chinese_translation: 经中以“随心转的诸法”等多种方式，已确立受等以识为缘。

rows.pali: Yuttito pana,
rows.english: But as to logic:
rows.chinese_translation: 从推理来说：

rows.pali: Cittajena hi rūpena, idha diṭṭhena sijjhati;
rows.english: From matter seen here to be born Of consciousness a man can tell
rows.chinese_translation: 这里已见心生色，

rows.pali: Adiṭṭhassāpi rūpassa, viññāṇaṃ paccayo iti.
rows.english: That consciousness is a condition For matter when unseen as well.
rows.chinese_translation: 所以可知未见的色，也以识为缘。

rows.pali: Citte hi pasanne appasanne vā tadanurūpāni rūpāni uppajjamānāni diṭṭhāni.
rows.english: Whether consciousness likes it or not, [certain] material instances are seen to arise in conformity with it.
rows.chinese_translation: 我们看见心清净或不清净时，会生起与它相应的色法。

rows.pali: Diṭṭhena ca adiṭṭhassa anumānaṃ hotīti iminā idha diṭṭhena cittajarūpena adiṭṭhassāpi paṭisandhirūpassa viññāṇaṃ paccayo hotīti jānitabbametaṃ.
rows.english: And the unseen is inferred from the seen. So it can be known, by means of the consciousness-born materiality that is seen, that consciousness is also a condition for the unseen materiality of rebirth-linking.
rows.chinese_translation: 既然可以由已见推知未见，所以应知，这里已经看见的心生色说明，未看见的结生色也以识为缘。

rows.pali: Kammasamuṭṭhānassāpi hi tassa cittasamuṭṭhānasseva viññāṇapaccayatā paṭṭhāne āgatāti.
rows.english: For it is said in the Paṭṭhāna that, like the consciousness-originated, also the kamma-originated has consciousness as its condition (see Paṭṭh I 172–73).
rows.chinese_translation: 即使是业生色，作为缘的识也如心生色一样；《发趣论》中已经这样说明。

rows.pali: Evaṃ paccayanayatopettha viññātabbo vinicchayoti.
rows.english: This is how the exposition should be known “by manner of condition. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 因此，这里的分析也应从缘的方式来理解。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ "viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpa"nti padasmiṃ vitthārakathā.
rows.english: This is the detailed explanation of the clause “With consciousness as condition, mentality-materiality. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是“以识为缘而有名色”一项的详细说明。

rows.pali: 641.Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanapade –
rows.english: 203. As to the clause “With mentality-materiality as condition, the sixfold base”:
rows.chinese_translation: 在“以名色为缘而有六处”一项中：

rows.pali: Nāmaṃ khandhattayaṃ rūpaṃ, bhūtavatthādikaṃ mataṃ;
rows.english: Three aggregates are “mind”; the basis, Primaries, and the rest are “matter”:
rows.chinese_translation: 名是三蕴，色是四大、所依处等；

rows.pali: Katekasesaṃ taṃ tassa, tādisasseva paccayo.
rows.english: And while all that conditions this A part can represent the rest.
rows.chinese_translation: 它们在扣除相应部分后，成为相应法的缘。

rows.pali: Yañhetaṃ saḷāyatanasseva paccayabhūtaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, tattha nāmanti vedanādikkhandhattayaṃ, rūpaṃ pana sasantatipariyāpannaṃ niyamato cattāri bhūtāni cha vatthūni jīvitindriyanti evaṃ bhūtavatthādikaṃ matanti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: 204. In the case of the mentality-materiality that is here a condition for the sixfold base, mentality is the three aggregates beginning with feeling, while materiality should be understood as that included in one’s own continuity stated thus “primaries and the rest are ‘matter’,” that is to say, the four primaries, six physical bases, and life faculty, [since they are conditioning factors] invariably.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里作为六处缘的名色中，名是受等三蕴；色则确定包括自身相续中的四大、六所依处、命根和食素等。

rows.pali: Taṃ pana nāmañca rūpañca nāmarūpañca nāmarūpanti evaṃ katekasesaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatananti evaṃ katekasesasseva saḷāyatanassa paccayoti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: But this mentality and this materiality and this mentality-materiality, each one representing the rest as “mentality-materiality,” should be understood as a condition for the sixfold base consisting of the sixth base and the sixfold base each one representing the rest as the “sixfold base.”
rows.chinese_translation: 应知，名和色合称名色；在扣除相应部分后，六处成为第六处，名色成为六处，正是以这种扣除后剩余的部分成为六处的缘。

rows.pali: Kasmā?
rows.english: Why?
rows.chinese_translation: 为什么？

rows.pali: Yasmā āruppe nāmameva paccayo, tañca chaṭṭhāyatanasseva na aññassa.
rows.english: Because in the immaterial becoming there is only mentality as a condition, and that is a condition only for the sixth base, [namely, the mind base,] not for any other.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为在无色有中，只有名成为缘，而且只成为第六处的缘，不成为其他处的缘。

rows.pali: "Nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatana"nti (vibha. 322) hi vibhaṅge vuttaṃ.
rows.english: For it is said in the Vibhaṅga, “With mentality as condition, the sixth base” (Vibh 179).
rows.chinese_translation: 《分别论》中说：以名为缘而有第六处。

rows.pali: Tattha siyā – kathaṃ panetaṃ jānitabbaṃ "nāmarūpaṃ saḷāyatanassa paccayo"ti?
rows.english: 205. Here it may be asked: “But how is it to be known that mentality-materiality is a condition for the sixfold base?”
rows.chinese_translation: 有人问：怎样知道名色是六处的缘？

rows.pali: Nāmarūpabhāve bhāvato.
rows.english: Because the latter exists when mentality- materiality exists.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为名色存在时，六处也存在。

rows.pali: Tassa tassa hi nāmassa rūpassa ca bhāve taṃ taṃ āyatanaṃ hoti, na aññathā.
rows.english: For a given base exists when a given kind of mentality and materiality exists, not otherwise.
rows.chinese_translation: 某一名或某一色存在时，相应的处才会存在，不可能以其他方式存在。

rows.pali: Sā panassa tabbhāvabhāvitā paccayanayasmiṃ yeva āvibhavissati.
rows.english: But the way in which the one comes to exist when the other does will be explained below in the section dealing with how it is a condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 它随名色存在而存在的缘由，将在缘的分析中说明。

rows.pali: Tasmā,
rows.english: Therefore:
rows.chinese_translation: 所以：

rows.pali: Paṭisandhiyā pavatte vā, hoti yaṃ yassa paccayo;
rows.english: A wise man should contrive to tell Which one conditions which, and how, At rebirth and in life as well;”
rows.chinese_translation: 无论在结生还是现行中，谁是哪些法的缘，

rows.pali: Yathā ca paccayo hoti, tathā neyyaṃ vibhāvinā.
rows.chinese_translation: 以及以什么方式成为缘，明智者都应如此理解。

rows.pali: Tatrāyamatthadīpanā –
rows.english: 206. Herein what follows illustrates the meaning.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里说明其意义。

rows.pali: Nāmameva hi āruppe, paṭisandhipavattisu;
rows.english: In immaterial rebirth And life the mind alone will come
rows.chinese_translation: 在无色有中只有名；在结生和现行时，

rows.pali: Paccayo sattadhā chadhā, hoti taṃ avakaṃsato.
rows.english: In seven ways and six to be Condition at the minimum.
rows.chinese_translation: 它对第六处以七种、最低六种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Kathaṃ?
rows.chinese_translation: 怎样成为缘？

rows.pali: Paṭisandhiyaṃ tāva avakaṃsato sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttavipākaatthiavigatapaccayehi sattadhā nāmaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanassa paccayo hoti.
rows.english: In rebirth-linking, firstly, mentality is a condition in seven ways at the minimum, as conascence, mutuality, support, association, kamma-result, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for the sixth base.
rows.chinese_translation: 先说结生时，最低限度的名以俱生、相互、依止、相应、异熟、有和不离去七种缘，成为第六处的缘。

rows.pali: Kiñci panettha hetupaccayena, kiñci āhārapaccayenāti evaṃ aññathāpi paccayo hoti, tassa vasena ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
rows.english: Some mentality, however, is a condition, as root-cause condition [that is, greed, etc.,] and some as nutriment condition [that is, contact and mental volition]. So it is also a condition in other ways. It is by the [two latter] that the maximum and minimum should be understood.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中有些还以因缘成为缘，有些以食缘成为缘；应依这些情况理解最高和最低的差别。

rows.pali: Pavattepi vipākaṃ vuttanayeneva paccayo hoti, itaraṃ pana avakaṃsato vuttappakāresu paccayesu vipākapaccayavajjehi chahi paccayehi paccayo hoti.
rows.english: In the course of an existence, too, resultant mentality is a condition as already stated. But the other [non-resultant] kind is a condition in six ways at minimum, as the aforesaid conditions except for kamma-result condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 在现行时，异熟名也依前述方式成为缘；其他名在最低限度时，除异熟缘外，以前述缘中的六种成为缘。

rows.pali: Kiñci panettha hetupaccayena, kiñci āhārapaccayenāti evaṃ aññathāpi paccayo hoti, tassa vasena ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
rows.english: Some, however, are a condition, as root-cause condition, and some as nutriment condition. So it is also a condition in other ways. It is by these that the maximum and minimum should be understood.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中有些以因缘、有些以食缘成为缘；应依这些情况理解最高和最低的差别。

rows.pali: Aññasmimpi bhave nāmaṃ, tatheva paṭisandhiyaṃ;
rows.english: 208. In five-constituent becoming At rebirth, mind in the same ways
rows.chinese_translation: 在其他有中，名在结生时也同样成为缘；

rows.pali: Chaṭṭhassa itaresaṃ taṃ, chahākārehi paccayo.
rows.english: Acts as condition for the sixth, And for the others in six ways.
rows.chinese_translation: 它对第六处以七种方式，对其余处以六种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Āruppato hi aññasmimpi pañcavokārabhave taṃ vipākanāmaṃ hadayavatthuno sahāyaṃ hutvā chaṭṭhassa manāyatanassa yathā āruppe vuttaṃ, tatheva avakaṃsato sattadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 209. Besides the immaterial states, also in the five-constituent becoming that resultant mentality, in association with the heart-basis, is a condition in seven ways at the minimum for the sixth, the mind base, in the same way as was said with respect to the immaterial states.
rows.chinese_translation: 在无色有以外的五蕴有中，异熟名依心所依处帮助第六意处，最低限度时以与无色有相同的七种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Itaresaṃ pana taṃ pañcannaṃ cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ catumahābhūtasahāyaṃ hutvā sahajātanissayavipākavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena chahākārehi paccayo hoti.
rows.english: But in association with the four primary elements, it is a condition in six ways, as conascence, support, kamma-result, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for the other five beginning with the eye base.
rows.chinese_translation: 但对其余五处，即眼等处，它以四大种为助伴，依俱生、依止、异熟、不相应、有和不离去六种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Kiñci panettha hetupaccayena, kiñci āhārapaccayenāti evaṃ aññathāpi paccayo hoti, tassa vasena ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
rows.english: Some, however, are a condition as root-cause condition, and some as nutriment condition. It is by these that the maximum and minimum should be understood.
rows.chinese_translation: 其中有些以因缘、有些以食缘成为缘；应依这些情况理解高下差别。

rows.pali: Pavattepi tathā hoti, pākaṃ pākassa paccayo;
rows.english: 210. Result is for result condition During a life in the same ways;
rows.chinese_translation: 在现行时也是如此：异熟成为异熟的缘，

rows.pali: Apākaṃ avipākassa, chadhā chaṭṭhassa paccayo.
rows.english: While non-result the non-resultant Sixth conditions in six ways.
rows.chinese_translation: 非异熟成为非异熟的缘；对第六处则以六种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Pavattepi hi pañcavokārabhave yathā paṭisandhiyaṃ, tatheva vipākanāmaṃ vipākassa chaṭṭhāyatanassa avakaṃsato sattadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 211. For, as in rebirth-linking, so also in the course of an existence in the five- constituent becoming, resultant mentality is a condition in the seven ways at minimum for the resultant sixth base.
rows.chinese_translation: 在五蕴有的现行中，异熟名如结生时一样，在最低限度以七种方式成为异熟第六处的缘。

rows.pali: Avipākaṃ pana avipākassa chaṭṭhassa avakaṃsatova tato vipākapaccayaṃ apanetvā chadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: But non-resultant mentality is a condition in six ways at minimum for the non-resultant sixth base, leaving out kamma- result condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 非异熟名在最低限度时，除去异熟缘，以六种方式成为非异熟第六处的缘。

rows.pali: Vuttanayeneva panettha ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
rows.english: The maximum and minimum should be understood in the way already stated.
rows.chinese_translation: 这里最高和最低的差别，应依前述方法理解。

rows.pali: Tattheva sesapañcannaṃ, vipākaṃ paccayo bhave;
rows.english: 212. And during life, result conditions The other five in fourfold way;
rows.chinese_translation: 在那里，对其余五处，异熟名成为缘；

rows.pali: Catudhā avipākampi, evameva pakāsitaṃ.
rows.english: The non-resultant kind can be Explained in the aforesaid way.
rows.chinese_translation: 非异熟名也同样以四种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Tattheva hi pavatte sesānaṃ cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ pañcannaṃ cakkhupasādādivatthukaṃ itarampi vipākanāmaṃ pacchājātavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayehi catudhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 213. Again, in the course of an existence, the other resultant mentality, which has as its physical basis the eye sensitivity, etc., is a condition in four ways, as postnascence, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for the rest of the five beginning with the eye base.
rows.chinese_translation: 在那里现行时，其余五处，即眼等处，以依身处的其他异熟名，依后生、不相应、有和不离去四种缘成为缘。

rows.pali: Yathā ca vipākaṃ, avipākampi evameva pakāsitaṃ.
rows.english: And as the resultant, so also the non-resultant is explained;
rows.chinese_translation: 非异熟名也以同样方式说明。

rows.pali: Tasmā kusalādibhedampi tesaṃ catudhā paccayo hotīti veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: therefore [the mentality] classed as profitable, etc., should be understood as their condition in four ways.
rows.chinese_translation: 所以应知，它们无论善等分类如何，都以四种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Evaṃ tāva nāmameva paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte vā yassa yassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti, yathā ca paccayo hoti, tathā veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: This, firstly, is how it should be understood what bases mentality alone is a condition for in rebirth-linking and in the course of an existence, and how it is a condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 以上应知：在结生和现行中，名成为哪些处的缘，以及以什么方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Rūpaṃ panettha āruppe, bhave bhavati paccayo;
rows.english: 214. Not even for a single base In immaterial becoming
rows.chinese_translation: 色在无色有中成为缘，

rows.pali: Na ekāyatanassāpi, pañcakkhandhabhave pana.
rows.english: Is matter a condition here. But in five-aggregate becoming
rows.chinese_translation: 在五蕴有中不成为任何一个处的缘。

rows.pali: Rūpato sandhiyaṃ vatthu, chadhā chaṭṭhassa paccayo;
rows.english: Basis as matter is condition At rebirth in a sixfold way
rows.chinese_translation: 结生时，色法所依处对第六处以六种方式成为缘；

rows.pali: Bhūtāni catudhā honti, pañcannaṃ avisesato.
rows.english: For the sixth base; the primaries Are for the five in fourfold way.
rows.chinese_translation: 四大种则无差别地对五处成为缘。

rows.pali: Rūpato hi paṭisandhiyaṃ vatthurūpaṃ chaṭṭhassa manāyatanassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayehi chadhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 215. As to matter, the materiality of the physical [heart-] basis is a condition in rebirth-linking in six ways, as conascence, mutuality, support, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for the sixth, the mind base.
rows.chinese_translation: 结生时，色法中的所依色，以俱生、相互、依止、不相应、有和不离去六种方式，成为第六意处的缘。

rows.pali: Cattāri pana bhūtāni avisesato paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca yaṃ yaṃ āyatanaṃ uppajjati, tassa tassa vasena pañcannampi cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ sahajātanissayaatthiavigatapaccayehi catudhā paccayā honti.
rows.english: But the four primaries are in general, that is to say, in rebirth-linking and in the course of an existence, conditions in four ways, as conascence, support, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for any of the five bases beginning with the eye, whenever they arise.
rows.chinese_translation: 四大种无差别地在结生和现行中，依各处生起情形，以俱生、依止、有和不离去四种方式成为眼等五处的缘。

rows.pali: Tidhā jīvitametesaṃ, āhāro ca pavattiyaṃ;
rows.english: 216. Life and in lifetime food as well. Conditions five in threefold way;
rows.chinese_translation: 这些法的命根有三种缘，食在现行时也有三种；

rows.pali: Tāneva chadhā chaṭṭhassa, vatthu tasseva pañcadhā.
rows.english: These five, the sixth in sixfold way; Basis, the sixth in fivefold way.
rows.chinese_translation: 它们对第六处有六种缘，所依色对第六处有五种缘。

rows.pali: Etesaṃ pana cakkhādīnaṃ pañcannaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca atthi avigataindriyavasena rūpajīvitaṃ tidhā paccayo hoti.
rows.english: 217. But in rebirth-linking and in the course of an existence the material life [faculty] is a condition in three ways, as presence, non-disappearance, and faculty conditions, for these five beginning with the eye.
rows.chinese_translation: 眼等五处在结生和现行中，以色命根的有、不离去和根三种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Āhāro ca atthiavigatāhāravasena tividhā paccayo hoti, so ca kho ye sattā āhārūpajīvino, tesaṃ āhārānugate kāye pavattiyaṃyeva, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: Nutriment too is a condition in three ways, as presence, non-disappearance, and nutriment conditions, and that is so in the course of an existence, not in rebirth-linking, and applies when the bodies of beings subsisting on nutriment are suffused with the nutriment.
rows.chinese_translation: 食以有、不离去和食三种方式成为缘；但只对依食而活的有情，在食物滋养的身体现行时成为缘，不在结生时成为缘。

rows.pali: Tāni pana pañca cakkhāyatanādīni chaṭṭhassa cakkhu sotaghānajivhākāyaviññāṇasaṅkhātassa manāyatanassa nissayapurejātaindriyavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena chahākārehi paccayā honti pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: In the course of an existence, not in rebirth-linking, those five bases beginning with the eye are conditions in six ways, as support, prenascence, faculty, dissociation, presence and non-disappearance conditions, for [that part of] the sixth, the mind base, comprising eye-, ear-, nose-, tongue-, and body-consciousness.
rows.chinese_translation: 眼等五处对第六意处，即眼识、耳识、鼻识、舌识和身识所构成的意处，以依止、前生、根、不相应、有和不离去六种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Ṭhapetvā pana pañcaviññāṇāni tasseva avasesamanāyatanassa vatthurūpaṃ nissayapurejātavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena pañcadhā paccayo hoti pavatteyeva, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
rows.english: But in the course of an existence, not at rebirth-linking, the materiality of the [heart- ] basis is a condition in five ways, as support, prenascence, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, for the remaining mind base apart from the five consciousnesses.
rows.chinese_translation: 除五识外，所依色对其余意处只在现行中，以依止、前生、不相应、有和不离去五种方式成为缘，不在结生时成为缘。

rows.pali: Evaṃ rūpameva paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte vā yassa yassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti, yathā ca paccayo hoti, tathā veditabbaṃ.
rows.english: This is how it should be understood what bases materiality alone is a condition for in rebirth-linking and in the course of an existence, and how it is a condition.
rows.chinese_translation: 以上应知色在结生和现行中成为哪些处的缘，以及以何种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Nāmarūpaṃ panubhayaṃ, hoti yaṃ yassa paccayo;
rows.english: 218. Which mind-cum-matter combination Is a condition for which kind
rows.chinese_translation: 名色二者合在一起，也各自成为相应诸法的缘。

rows.pali: Yathā ca tampi sabbattha, viññātabbaṃ vibhāvinā.
rows.english: And how it is so in each case, A wise man should now seek to find.
rows.chinese_translation: 明智者应在一切地方理解它们成为哪些法的缘，以及以何种方式成为缘。

rows.pali: Seyyathidaṃ.
rows.english: 219. For example,
rows.chinese_translation: 例如：

rows.pali: Paṭisandhiyaṃ tāva pañcavokārabhave khandhattayavatthurūpasaṅkhātaṃ nāmarūpaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayavipākasampayuttavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayādīhi paccayo hotīti.
rows.english: firstly, in rebirth-linking in the five-constituent becoming, the mentality-materiality, in other words, the trio of aggregates with the materiality of the [heart-] basis, is a condition, as conascence, mutuality, support, kamma- result, association, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions, etc., for the sixth, the mind base.
rows.chinese_translation: 先说五蕴有的结生：由三蕴和所依色构成的名色，以俱生、相互、依止、异熟、相应、不相应、有和不离去等缘，成为第六处的缘。

rows.pali: Idamettha mukhamattaṃ.
rows.english: This is merely the heading;
rows.chinese_translation: 这里先只作一个概要说明。

rows.pali: Vuttanayānusārena pana sakkā sabbaṃ yojetunti na ettha vitthāro dassitoti.
rows.english: but since it can all be construed in the way already stated, the detail is not given here.
rows.chinese_translation: 依照前述方法，一切关系都可以配合说明，所以不再详细展开。

rows.pali: Ayaṃ "nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatana"nti padasmiṃ vitthārakathā.
rows.english: This is the detailed explanation of the clause “With mentality-materiality as condition, the sixfold base.
rows.chinese_translation: 这就是“以名色为缘而有六处”的详细说明。

rows.pali: 642.Saḷāyatanapaccayā phassapade –
rows.english: 220. As to the clause “With the sixfold base as condition, contact”:
rows.chinese_translation: 在“以六处为缘而有触”一项中：

rows.pali: Saḷeva phassā saṅkhepā, cakkhusamphassaādayo;
rows.english: Contact is briefly of six kinds With eye-contact and others too;
rows.chinese_translation: 简略说只有六种触，即眼触等；

rows.pali: Viññāṇamiva bāttiṃsa, vitthārena bhavanti te.
rows.english: According to each consciousness It is in detail thirty-two.
rows.chinese_translation: 详细说如识一样，有三十二种。

rows.pali: Saṅkhepena hi saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphassoti ime cakkhusamphassādayo cha eva phassā bhavanti.
rows.english: 221. Briefly, with the clause “With the sixfold base as condition, contact,” there are only the six kinds beginning with eye-contact, that is to say, eye-contact, ear-contact, nose-contact, tongue-contact, body-contact, and mind-contact.
rows.chinese_translation: 简略说，以六处为缘的触就是眼触、耳触、鼻触、舌触、身触和意触，共六种。

rows.pali: Vitthārena pana cakkhusamphassādayo pañca kusalavipākā, pañca akusalavipākāti dasa, sesā bāvīsati-lokiyavipākaviññāṇasampayuttā ca bāvīsatīti evaṃ sabbepi saṅkhārapaccayā vuttaviññāṇamiva bāttiṃsa honti.
rows.english: But in detail the five profitable resultant and the five unprofitable resultant beginning with eye-contact make ten; the rest, which are associated with the twenty-two kinds of mundane resultant consciousness, make twenty-two. So all these come to thirty-two ((34)–(65)), like the consciousness with formations as condition given above.
rows.chinese_translation: 详细说，眼触等五种各有善异熟和不善异熟，共十种；其余二十二种与世间异熟识相应，共三十二种。

rows.pali: Yaṃ panetassa bāttiṃsavidhassāpi phassassa paccayo saḷāyatanaṃ, tattha,
rows.english: 222. But as to the sixfold base that is a condition for this thirty-twofold contact. Herein:
rows.chinese_translation: 作为这三十二种触的缘的六处，其中：

rows.pali: Chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ, cakkhādiṃ bāhirehipi;
rows.english: Some wise men take the sixfold base To be the five internal bases
rows.chinese_translation: 有智者认为，内在以第六处为一方，外在以眼等处为另一方，连同六处，才称为六处。

rows.pali: Saḷāyatanamicchanti, chahi saddhiṃ vicakkhaṇā.
rows.english: With the sixth; but others count These plus the six external bases.
rows.chinese_translation: 六处应理解为内在的眼等五处连同第六处。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Tattha ye tāva "upādiṇṇakapavattikathā aya"nti sakasantatipariyāpannameva paccayaṃ paccayuppannañca dīpenti, te "chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso"ti (vibha. 322) pāḷianusārato āruppe chaṭṭhāyatanañca, aññattha sabbasaṅgahato saḷāyatanañca phassassa paccayoti ekadesasarūpekasesaṃ katvā chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ cakkhādiṃ saḷāyatananti icchanti.
rows.english: 223. Herein, firstly, there are those who take this to be an exposition of the occurrence of what is clung to, [that is, kammically-acquired aggregates,] and they maintain that the conditioning [bases] and the conditionally-arisen [contact] are only what is included in one’s own continuity. They take any one part to represent any remaining one of its kind, since the condition for contact in the immaterial states is the sixth base [only], according to the text “With the sixth base as condition, contact” (Vibh 179), and elsewhere it is the sixfold base inclusively. So they have it that “sixfold base” means the internal [five] beginning with the eye plus the sixth (mind) base.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为第六处和六处合并计算，仍称为六处。

rows.pali: Tañhi chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatanantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
rows.english: For that sixth base and that sixfold base are styled “sixfold base. ”
rows.chinese_translation: 因为第六处和六处合并计算，仍称为六处。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Ye pana paccayuppannameva ekasantatipariyāpannaṃ dīpenti, paccayaṃ pana bhinnasantānampi, te yaṃ yaṃ āyatanaṃ phassassa paccayo hoti, taṃ sabbampi dīpentā bāhirampi pariggahetvā tadeva chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ bāhirehipi rūpāyatanādīhi saddhiṃ saḷāyatananti icchanti.
rows.english: But there are those who maintain that it is only the conditionally-arisen [contact] that is contained in a single continuity, while the conditioning [bases] are contained in separate [that is, past] continuities as well. They maintain that all and any such bases are a condition for contact, and they include also the [six] external ones. So they have it that “sixfold base” means the same internal [five] plus the sixth plus the external ones beginning with visible data.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为第六处和六处合并计算，仍称为六处。

rows.pali: Tampi hi chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatananti etesaṃ ekasese kate saḷāyatanantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
rows.english: For that sixth base and that [partial] sixfold base and the sixfold base along with these [external ones] each representing the rest [566] are styled sixfold base too.
rows.chinese_translation: 因为第六处和六处合并后只取一名，所以仍称为六处。
translation_note: 经相邻 Pāli 逐条复核，原译文与相邻记录错位；已按本条 pali 重新核对。

rows.pali: Etthāha – na sabbāyatanehi eko phasso sambhoti, nāpi ekamhā āyatanā sabbe phassā, ayañca saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti ekova vutto, so kasmāti.
rows.english: 224. Here it may be asked: “One kind of contact does not derive from all the bases, nor all the kinds of contact from one base. And yet ‘With the sixfold base as condition, contact’ is said in the singular. Why is that? ”
rows.chinese_translation: 回答是：确实，一切处不会产生一个触，一个处也不会产生一切触，但多个处可以产生一个触。
